263: static void update_time_ui(bool force)
264: {
265:   static const char *weekdays[] =
266:   {
267:     "星期日", "星期一", "星期二", "星期三",
268:     "星期四", "星期五", "星期六"
269:   };
270:   struct tm local_time;
271:   char clock_text[16];
272:   char date_text[48];
273:   uint32_t now_ms = lv_tick_get();
274:   time_t now;
275:   int ret;
276: 
277:   if (!force && lv_tick_elaps(g_last_time_update) <
278:       TIME_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS)
279:     {
280:       return;
281:     }
282: 
283:   g_last_time_update = now_ms;
284:   if (g_network_state == NETWORK_ONLINE && !g_ntp_started &&
285:       (g_next_ntp_attempt == 0 ||
286:        (int32_t)(now_ms - g_next_ntp_attempt) >= 0))
287:     {
288:       ret = ntpc_start();
289:       if (ret >= 0 || ret == -EALREADY)
290:         {
291:           g_ntp_started = true;
292:           syslog(LOG_INFO, "[HOME][TIME] ntp client started pid=%d\n",
293:                  ret);
294:         }
295:       else
296:         {
297:           g_next_ntp_attempt = now_ms + NTP_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS;
298:           syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][TIME] ntp start failed ret=%d\n",
299:                  ret);
300:         }
301:     }
302: 
303:   now = time(NULL);
304:   if (now < TIME_VALID_EPOCH)
305:     {
306:       if (g_clock_label != NULL)
307:         {
308:           set_label_text_if_changed(g_clock_label, "--:--");
309:         }
310:       if (g_date_label != NULL)
311:         {
312:           set_label_text_if_changed(g_date_label, "等待网络校时");
313:         }
314:       return;
315:     }
316: 
317:   if (!g_time_synced)
318:     {
319:       g_time_synced = true;
320:       syslog(LOG_INFO, "[HOME][TIME] synchronized epoch=%ld timezone=UTC+8\n",
321:              (long)now);
322:     }
323: 
324:   now += 8 * 60 * 60;
325:   gmtime_r(&now, &local_time);
326:   snprintf(clock_text, sizeof(clock_text), "%02d:%02d",
327:            local_time.tm_hour, local_time.tm_min);
328:   snprintf(date_text, sizeof(date_text), "%d月%d日  %s",
329:            local_time.tm_mon + 1, local_time.tm_mday,
330:            weekdays[local_time.tm_wday]);
331:   if (g_clock_label != NULL)
332:     {
333:       set_label_text_if_changed(g_clock_label, clock_text);
334:     }
335:   if (g_date_label != NULL)
336:     {
337:       set_label_text_if_changed(g_date_label, date_text);
338:     }
339: }

416: static uint16_t network_ping_checksum(const void *buffer, size_t length)
417: {
418:   const uint16_t *word = buffer;
419:   uint32_t sum = 0;
420: 
421:   while (length > 1)
422:     {
423:       sum += *word++;
424:       length -= 2;
425:     }
426: 
427:   if (length != 0)
428:     {
429:       sum += *(const uint8_t *)word;
430:     }
431: 
432:   while ((sum >> 16) != 0)
433:     {
434:       sum = (sum & 0xffff) + (sum >> 16);
435:     }
436: 
437:   return (uint16_t)~sum;
438: }

506: static bool network_dns_skip_name(const uint8_t *message, size_t length,
507:                                   size_t *offset)
508: {
509:   while (*offset < length)
510:     {
511:       uint8_t label_length = message[(*offset)++];
512: 
513:       if (label_length == 0)
514:         {
515:           return true;
516:         }
517: 
518:       if ((label_length & 0xc0) == 0xc0)
519:         {
520:           if (*offset >= length)
521:             {
522:               return false;
523:             }
524: 
525:           (*offset)++;
526:           return true;
527:         }
528: 
529:       if (label_length > 63 || *offset + label_length > length)
530:         {
531:           return false;
532:         }
533: 
534:       *offset += label_length;
535:     }
536: 
537:   return false;
538: }

540: static bool network_resolve_host(const char *hostname,
541:                                  struct in_addr *resolved_address)
542: {
543:   struct sockaddr_in dns_server;
544:   uint8_t query[NETWORK_DNS_BUFFER_SIZE];
545:   uint8_t response[NETWORK_DNS_BUFFER_SIZE];
546:   struct dns_header_s *header = (struct dns_header_s *)query;
547:   const char *label = hostname;
548:   uint16_t query_id = ++g_network_dns_id;
549:   if (query_id == 0)
550:     {
551:       query_id = ++g_network_dns_id;
552:     }
553:   size_t query_length = sizeof(struct dns_header_s);
554:   unsigned int poll_count;
555:   int sockfd;
556:   int ret;
557: 
558:   if (!network_get_dns_server(&dns_server))
559:     {
560:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-server=missing\n",
561:              hostname);
562:       return false;
563:     }
564: 
565:   memset(query, 0, sizeof(query));
566:   header->id = htons(query_id);
567:   header->flags1 = DNS_FLAG1_RD;
568:   header->numquestions = htons(1);
569: 
570:   while (*label != '\0')
571:     {
572:       const char *dot = strchr(label, '.');
573:       size_t label_length = dot == NULL ? strlen(label) :
574:                                           (size_t)(dot - label);
575: 
576:       if (label_length == 0 || label_length > 63 ||
577:           query_length + label_length + 6 > sizeof(query))
578:         {
579:           return false;
580:         }
581: 
582:       query[query_length++] = (uint8_t)label_length;
583:       memcpy(&query[query_length], label, label_length);
584:       query_length += label_length;
585:       if (dot == NULL)
586:         {
587:           break;
588:         }
589: 
590:       label = dot + 1;
591:     }
592: 
593:   query[query_length++] = 0;
594:   network_dns_write_u16(&query[query_length], DNS_RECTYPE_A);
595:   query_length += 2;
596:   network_dns_write_u16(&query[query_length], DNS_CLASS_IN);
597:   query_length += 2;
598: 
599:   sockfd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
600:   if (sockfd < 0)
601:     {
602:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-socket=%d\n",
603:              hostname, errno);
604:       return false;
605:     }
606: 
607:   if (fcntl(sockfd, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) < 0)
608:     {
609:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-nonblock=%d\n",
610:              hostname, errno);
611:       close(sockfd);
612:       return false;
613:     }
614: 
615:   ret = sendto(sockfd, query, query_length, MSG_DONTWAIT,
616:                (const struct sockaddr *)&dns_server,
617:                sizeof(dns_server));
618:   if (ret != (int)query_length)
619:     {
620:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-send=%d errno=%d\n",
621:              hostname, ret, errno);
622:       close(sockfd);
623:       return false;
624:     }
625: 
626:   for (poll_count = 0; poll_count < NETWORK_PING_POLLS; poll_count++)
627:     {
628:       ssize_t received;
629: 
630:       received = recvfrom(sockfd, response, sizeof(response),
631:                           MSG_DONTWAIT, NULL, NULL);
632:       if (received >= (ssize_t)sizeof(struct dns_header_s))
633:         {
634:           struct dns_header_s *response_header =
635:             (struct dns_header_s *)response;
636:           size_t offset = sizeof(struct dns_header_s);
637:           unsigned int index;
638: 
639:           if (ntohs(response_header->id) != query_id ||
640:               (response_header->flags1 & DNS_FLAG1_RESPONSE) == 0 ||
641:               (response_header->flags2 & DNS_FLAG2_ERR_MASK) != 0)
642:             {
643:               continue;
644:             }
645: 
646:           for (index = 0;
647:                index < ntohs(response_header->numquestions); index++)
648:             {
649:               if (!network_dns_skip_name(response, received, &offset) ||
650:                   offset + 4 > (size_t)received)
651:                 {
652:                   break;
653:                 }
654: 
655:               offset += 4;
656:             }
657: 
658:           for (index = 0; index < ntohs(response_header->numanswers);
659:                index++)
660:             {
661:               uint16_t record_type;
662:               uint16_t record_class;
663:               uint16_t record_length;
664: 
665:               if (!network_dns_skip_name(response, received, &offset) ||
666:                   offset + 10 > (size_t)received)
667:                 {
668:                   break;
669:                 }
670: 
671:               record_type = network_dns_read_u16(&response[offset]);
672:               record_class = network_dns_read_u16(&response[offset + 2]);
673:               record_length = network_dns_read_u16(&response[offset + 8]);
674:               offset += 10;
675:               if (offset + record_length > (size_t)received)
676:                 {
677:                   break;
678:                 }
679: 
680:               if (record_type == DNS_RECTYPE_A &&
681:                   record_class == DNS_CLASS_IN && record_length == 4)
682:                 {
683:                   memcpy(resolved_address, &response[offset], 4);
684:                   close(sockfd);
685:                   return true;
686:                 }
687: 
688:               offset += record_length;
689:             }
690:         }
691:       else if (received < 0 && errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK &&
692:                errno != EINTR)
693:         {
694:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
695:                  "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-recv=%d\n", hostname, errno);
696:           break;
697:         }
698: 
699:       usleep(NETWORK_PING_POLL_US);
700:     }
701: 
702:   syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s dns-timeout\n", hostname);
703:   close(sockfd);
704:   return false;
705: }

707: static int network_ping_host(const char *hostname)
708: {
709:   struct network_ping_packet_s packet;
710:   struct sockaddr_in destination;
711:   uint8_t receive_buffer[64];
712:   uint16_t ping_id;
713:   unsigned int poll_count;
714:   int sockfd;
715:   int ret;
716: 
717:   memset(&destination, 0, sizeof(destination));
718:   destination.sin_family = AF_INET;
719:   if (!network_resolve_host(hostname, &destination.sin_addr))
720:     {
721:       return 0;
722:     }
723: 
724:   sockfd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_RAW, IPPROTO_ICMP);
725:   if (sockfd < 0)
726:     {
727:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s socket=%d\n",
728:              hostname, errno);
729:       return 0;
730:     }
731: 
732:   if (fcntl(sockfd, F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK) < 0)
733:     {
734:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s nonblock=%d\n",
735:              hostname, errno);
736:       close(sockfd);
737:       return 0;
738:     }
739: 
740:   memset(&packet, 0, sizeof(packet));
741:   ping_id = ++g_network_ping_id;
742:   if (ping_id == 0)
743:     {
744:       ping_id = ++g_network_ping_id;
745:     }
746: 
747:   packet.header.type = ICMP_ECHO_REQUEST;
748:   packet.header.id = htons(ping_id);
749:   packet.header.seqno = htons(1);
750:   memset(packet.data, 0x5a, sizeof(packet.data));
751:   packet.header.icmpchksum = network_ping_checksum(&packet,
752:                                                    sizeof(packet));
753: 
754:   ret = sendto(sockfd, &packet, sizeof(packet), MSG_DONTWAIT,
755:                (const struct sockaddr *)&destination,
756:                sizeof(destination));
757:   if (ret != (int)sizeof(packet))
758:     {
759:       syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s send=%d errno=%d\n",
760:              hostname, ret, errno);
761:       close(sockfd);
762:       return 0;
763:     }
764: 
765:   for (poll_count = 0; poll_count < NETWORK_PING_POLLS; poll_count++)
766:     {
767:       ssize_t received;
768:       size_t offset = 0;
769:       struct icmp_hdr_s *reply;
770: 
771:       received = recvfrom(sockfd, receive_buffer, sizeof(receive_buffer),
772:                           MSG_DONTWAIT, NULL, NULL);
773:       if (received > 0)
774:         {
775:           if ((receive_buffer[0] >> 4) == 4)
776:             {
777:               offset = (receive_buffer[0] & 0x0f) * 4;
778:             }
779: 
780:           if ((size_t)received >= offset + sizeof(struct icmp_hdr_s))
781:             {
782:               reply = (struct icmp_hdr_s *)(receive_buffer + offset);
783:               if (reply->type == ICMP_ECHO_REPLY &&
784:                   ntohs(reply->id) == ping_id &&
785:                   ntohs(reply->seqno) == 1)
786:                 {
787:                   close(sockfd);
788:                   return 1;
789:                 }
790:             }
791:         }
792:       else if (errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK && errno != EINTR)
793:         {
794:           syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[HOME][NET] host=%s recv=%d\n",
795:                  hostname, errno);
796:           break;
797:         }
798: 
799:       usleep(NETWORK_PING_POLL_US);
800:     }
801: 
802:   close(sockfd);
803:   return 0;
804: }

806: static void *network_worker(void *arg)
807: {
808:   unsigned int elapsed = NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL;
809:   unsigned int initial_down_seconds = 0;
810:   bool was_connected = false;
811:   bool link_seen = false;
812:   enum network_link_state_e last_link = NETWORK_LINK_INITIALIZING;
813:   uint8_t last_flags = UINT8_MAX;
814: 
815:   (void)arg;
816: 
817:   for (;;)
818:     {
819:       uint8_t flags;
820:       enum network_link_state_e link = network_get_link_state(&flags);
821:       bool connected = link == NETWORK_LINK_UP;
822:       bool refresh = g_network_refresh_requested;
823:       struct in_addr address;
824: 
825:       if (link != last_link || flags != last_flags)
826:         {
827:           const char *link_name = link == NETWORK_LINK_UP ? "up" :
828:                                   link == NETWORK_LINK_DOWN ? "down" :
829:                                   "initializing";
830: 
831:           syslog(LOG_INFO, "[HOME][NET] carrier=%s flags=%02x\n",
832:                  link_name, flags);
833:           last_link = link;
834:           last_flags = flags;
835:         }
836: 
837:       g_network_refresh_requested = false;
838:       if (link == NETWORK_LINK_INITIALIZING)
839:         {
840:           network_set_state(NETWORK_INITIALIZING);
841:           was_connected = false;
842:           elapsed = NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL;
843:           initial_down_seconds = 0;
844:         }
845:       else if (!connected)
846:         {
847:           if (!link_seen && initial_down_seconds < NETWORK_LINK_GRACE_SEC)
848:             {
849:               network_set_state(NETWORK_INITIALIZING);
850:               initial_down_seconds++;
851:             }
852:           else
853:             {
854:               network_set_state(NETWORK_DISCONNECTED);
855:             }
856:           was_connected = false;
857:           elapsed = NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL;
858:         }
859:       else if (!network_get_ipv4_address(&address))
860:         {
861:           /* DHCP runs independently. Keep checking without reporting a
862:            * false Internet failure while an address is being acquired.
863:            */
864: 
865:           network_set_state(NETWORK_CHECKING);
866:           link_seen = true;
867:           initial_down_seconds = 0;
868:           was_connected = false;
869:         }
870:       else if (!was_connected || refresh ||
871:                elapsed >= NETWORK_PROBE_INTERVAL)
872:         {
873:           int replies;
874:           char address_text[INET_ADDRSTRLEN];
875: 
876:           /* Keep the last definitive result visible during an automatic
877:            * background probe.  Only initial and user-requested probes show
878:            * the transient checking state.
879:            */
880: 
881:           if (!was_connected || refresh)
882:             {
883:               network_set_state(NETWORK_CHECKING);
884:             }
885:           link_seen = true;
886:           initial_down_seconds = 0;
887:           inet_ntop(AF_INET, &address, address_text, sizeof(address_text));
888:           replies = network_ping_host("mi.com");
889:           if (replies <= 0 && network_has_carrier())
890:             {
891:               replies = network_ping_host("xiaomi.cn");
892:             }
893: 
894:           if (!network_has_carrier())
895:             {
896:               network_set_state(NETWORK_DISCONNECTED);
897:             }
898:           else
899:             {
900:               network_set_state(replies > 0 ? NETWORK_ONLINE :
901:                                               NETWORK_NO_INTERNET);
902:               syslog(LOG_INFO,
903:                      "[HOME][NET] health ipv4=%s result=%s\n",
904:                      address_text, replies > 0 ? "online" : "unreachable");
905:             }
906: 
907:           was_connected = true;
908:           elapsed = 0;
909:         }
910:       else
911:         {
912:           elapsed++;
913:         }
914: 
915:       sleep(1);
916:     }
917: 
918:   return NULL;
919: }

921: static int start_network_monitor(void)
922: {
923:   pthread_attr_t attr;
924:   struct sched_param param;
925:   pthread_t thread;
926:   int ret;
927: 
928:   ret = pthread_attr_init(&attr);
929:   if (ret != 0)
930:     {
931:       return ret;
932:     }
933: 
934:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, NETWORK_THREAD_STACK);
935:   pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attr, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
936:   memset(&param, 0, sizeof(param));
937:   param.sched_priority = NETWORK_THREAD_PRIORITY;
938:   pthread_attr_setschedparam(&attr, &param);
939:   pthread_attr_setinheritsched(&attr, PTHREAD_EXPLICIT_SCHED);
940:   ret = pthread_create(&thread, &attr, network_worker, NULL);
941:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
942:   return ret;
943: }

1075: static bool login_update_qr(
1076:   const struct home_panel_mijia_snapshot_s *snapshot)
1077: {
1078:   lv_image_header_t header;
1079:   lv_area_t area;
1080:   uint8_t *data;
1081:   size_t size;
1082:   unsigned int dark_pixels = 0;
1083:   size_t offset;
1084:   int ret;
1085: 
1086:   if (snapshot->qr_size == 0)
1087:     {
1088:       return false;
1089:     }
1090: 
1091:   if (g_login_qr_data != NULL &&
1092:       g_login_qr_revision == snapshot->qr_revision)
1093:     {
1094:       lv_image_set_src(g_login_qr, &g_login_qr_image);
1095:       if (lv_image_get_src(g_login_qr) != &g_login_qr_image)
1096:         {
1097:           syslog(LOG_ERR, "[HOME][UI] qr source rejected on reuse\n");
1098:           return false;
1099:         }
1100: 
1101:       lv_obj_remove_flag(g_login_qr, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
1102:       lv_obj_invalidate(g_login_qr);
1103:       return true;
1104:     }
1105: 
1106:   data = malloc(snapshot->qr_size);
1107:   if (data == NULL)
1108:     {
1109:       return false;
1110:     }
1111: 
1112:   ret = home_panel_mijia_copy_qr(snapshot->qr_revision, data,
1113:                                  snapshot->qr_size, &size);
1114:   if (ret < 0)
1115:     {
1116:       free(data);
1117:       return false;
1118:     }
1119: 
1120:   if (g_login_qr_data != NULL)
1121:     {
1122:       lv_image_cache_drop(&g_login_qr_image);
1123:       lv_image_set_src(g_login_qr, NULL);
1124:       free(g_login_qr_data);
1125:     }
1126: 
1127:   memset(&g_login_qr_image, 0, sizeof(g_login_qr_image));
1128:   g_login_qr_data = data;
1129:   g_login_qr_revision = snapshot->qr_revision;
1130:   g_login_qr_image.header.magic = LV_IMAGE_HEADER_MAGIC;
1131:   g_login_qr_image.header.cf = LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB565;
1132:   g_login_qr_image.header.w = 240;
1133:   g_login_qr_image.header.h = 240;
1134:   g_login_qr_image.header.stride = 480;
1135:   g_login_qr_image.data_size = size;
1136:   g_login_qr_image.data = data;
1137: 
1138:   memset(&header, 0, sizeof(header));
1139:   if (lv_image_decoder_get_info(&g_login_qr_image, &header) !=
1140:       LV_RESULT_OK || header.cf != LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB565 ||
1141:       header.w != 240 || header.h != 240 || header.stride != 480)
1142:     {
1143:       syslog(LOG_ERR,
1144:              "[HOME][UI] qr decoder rejected descriptor cf=%u %ux%u stride=%u\n",
1145:              (unsigned int)header.cf, (unsigned int)header.w,
1146:              (unsigned int)header.h, (unsigned int)header.stride);
1147:       free(g_login_qr_data);
1148:       g_login_qr_data = NULL;
1149:       g_login_qr_revision = 0;
1150:       memset(&g_login_qr_image, 0, sizeof(g_login_qr_image));
1151:       return false;
1152:     }
1153: 
1154:   for (offset = 0; offset + 1 < size; offset += 2)
1155:     {
1156:       if (data[offset] == 0 && data[offset + 1] == 0)
1157:         {
1158:           dark_pixels++;
1159:         }
1160:     }
1161: 
1162:   lv_image_set_src(g_login_qr, &g_login_qr_image);
1163:   if (lv_image_get_src(g_login_qr) != &g_login_qr_image)
1164:     {
1165:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "[HOME][UI] qr source rejected after decode\n");
1166:       free(g_login_qr_data);
1167:       g_login_qr_data = NULL;
1168:       g_login_qr_revision = 0;
1169:       memset(&g_login_qr_image, 0, sizeof(g_login_qr_image));
1170:       return false;
1171:     }
1172: 
1173:   lv_obj_remove_flag(g_login_qr, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
1174:   lv_obj_move_foreground(g_login_qr);
1175:   lv_obj_invalidate(g_login_qr);
1176:   lv_obj_update_layout(g_login_qr);
1177:   lv_obj_get_coords(g_login_qr, &area);
1178:   syslog(LOG_INFO,
1179:          "[HOME][UI] qr ready RGB565 240x240 bytes=%u dark=%u "
1180:          "area=%d,%d-%d,%d hidden=%u revision=%u\n",
1181:          (unsigned int)size, dark_pixels,
1182:          (int)area.x1, (int)area.y1, (int)area.x2, (int)area.y2,
1183:          lv_obj_has_flag(g_login_qr, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN) ? 1 : 0,
1184:          (unsigned int)snapshot->qr_revision);
1185:   return true;
1186: }

239: static int mijia_http_request(const char *method, const char *path,
240:                               const char *body, char *response_data,
241:                               size_t response_capacity,
242:                               unsigned int *http_status)
243: {
244:   static const char *json_headers[] =
245:   {
246:     "Accept: application/json",
247:     "Content-Type: application/json",
248:     "Connection: close"
249:   };
250:   static const char *get_headers[] =
251:   {
252:     "Accept: application/json",
253:     "Connection: close"
254:   };
255:   struct webclient_context context;
256:   struct mijia_response_s response;
257:   char url[512];
258:   char buffer[MIJIA_HTTP_BUFFER_SIZE];
259:   int length;
260:   int ret;
261: 
262:   length = snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s%s",
263:                     CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL, path);
264:   if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(url))
265:     {
266:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
267:     }
268: 
269:   memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
270:   response.data = response_data;
271:   response.capacity = response_capacity;
272:   response_data[0] = '\0';
273: 
274:   webclient_set_defaults(&context);
275:   context.method = method;
276:   context.url = url;
277:   context.buffer = buffer;
278:   context.buflen = sizeof(buffer);
279:   context.sink_callback = mijia_response_sink;
280:   context.sink_callback_arg = &response;
281:   context.timeout_sec = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_TIMEOUT;
282: 
283:   if (body != NULL)
284:     {
285:       context.headers = json_headers;
286:       context.nheaders = sizeof(json_headers) / sizeof(json_headers[0]);
287:       webclient_set_static_body(&context, body, strlen(body));
288:     }
289:   else
290:     {
291:       context.headers = get_headers;
292:       context.nheaders = sizeof(get_headers) / sizeof(get_headers[0]);
293:     }
294: 
295:   ret = webclient_perform(&context);
296:   *http_status = context.http_status;
297:   if (ret < 0)
298:     {
299:       syslog(LOG_WARNING,
300:              "[HOME][MIJIA] %s %s transport=%d status=%u\n",
301:              method, path, ret, context.http_status);
302:       return ret;
303:     }
304: 
305:   if (context.http_status < 200 || context.http_status >= 300)
306:     {
307:       syslog(LOG_WARNING,
308:              "[HOME][MIJIA] %s %s status=%u bytes=%u\n",
309:              method, path, context.http_status,
310:              (unsigned int)response.length);
311:       return -EPROTO;
312:     }
313: 
314:   return 0;
315: }

561: static int mijia_download_login_qr(const char *session_id,
562:                                    uint32_t generation)
563: {
564:   static const char *headers[] =
565:   {
566:     "Accept: application/octet-stream",
567:     "Connection: close"
568:   };
569:   struct webclient_context context;
570:   struct mijia_response_s sink;
571:   char path[96];
572:   char url[512];
573:   char http_buffer[MIJIA_HTTP_BUFFER_SIZE];
574:   uint8_t *wire_data;
575:   int length;
576:   int ret;
577: 
578:   wire_data = malloc(MIJIA_QR_WIRE_SIZE);
579:   if (wire_data == NULL)
580:     {
581:       return -ENOMEM;
582:     }
583: 
584:   length = snprintf(path, sizeof(path),
585:                     "/api/login/qr.rgb565?session_id=%s", session_id);
586:   if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(path))
587:     {
588:       free(wire_data);
589:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
590:     }
591: 
592:   length = snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s%s",
593:                     CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL, path);
594:   if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(url))
595:     {
596:       free(wire_data);
597:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
598:     }
599: 
600:   memset(&sink, 0, sizeof(sink));
601:   sink.data = (char *)wire_data;
602:   sink.capacity = MIJIA_QR_WIRE_SIZE;
603:   webclient_set_defaults(&context);
604:   context.method = "GET";
605:   context.url = url;
606:   context.buffer = http_buffer;
607:   context.buflen = sizeof(http_buffer);
608:   context.headers = headers;
609:   context.nheaders = sizeof(headers) / sizeof(headers[0]);
610:   context.sink_callback = mijia_binary_sink;
611:   context.sink_callback_arg = &sink;
612:   context.timeout_sec = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_TIMEOUT;
613:   ret = webclient_perform(&context);
614:   if (ret >= 0 && (context.http_status < 200 || context.http_status >= 300))
615:     {
616:       ret = -EPROTO;
617:     }
618: 
619:   if (ret >= 0 &&
620:       (sink.length != MIJIA_QR_WIRE_SIZE ||
621:        memcmp(wire_data, "HQR2", 4) != 0 ||
622:        wire_data[4] != 0 || wire_data[5] != MIJIA_QR_WIDTH ||
623:        wire_data[6] != 0 || wire_data[7] != MIJIA_QR_HEIGHT ||
624:        wire_data[8] != (MIJIA_QR_STRIDE >> 8) ||
625:        wire_data[9] != (MIJIA_QR_STRIDE & 0xff) ||
626:        wire_data[10] != 2 || wire_data[11] != 0))
627:     {
628:       ret = -EBADMSG;
629:     }
630: 
631:   if (ret >= 0)
632:     {
633:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
634:       if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation)
635:         {
636:           ret = -ECANCELED;
637:         }
638:       else
639:         {
640:           memcpy(g_mijia_qr_data,
641:                  wire_data + MIJIA_QR_WIRE_HEADER_SIZE,
642:                  MIJIA_QR_DATA_SIZE);
643:           g_mijia.qr_size = MIJIA_QR_DATA_SIZE;
644:           g_mijia.snapshot.qr_size = MIJIA_QR_DATA_SIZE;
645:           g_mijia.snapshot.qr_revision = ++g_mijia.next_qr_revision;
646:           syslog(LOG_INFO,
647:                  "[HOME][MIJIA] qr downloaded format=RGB565 %ux%u bytes=%u\n",
648:                  MIJIA_QR_WIDTH, MIJIA_QR_HEIGHT,
649:                  (unsigned int)MIJIA_QR_DATA_SIZE);
650:         }
651:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
652:     }
653:   else
654:     {
655:       syslog(LOG_WARNING,
656:              "[HOME][MIJIA] qr download failed ret=%d status=%u bytes=%u\n",
657:              ret, context.http_status, (unsigned int)sink.length);
658:     }
659: 
660:   free(wire_data);
661:   return ret;
662: }

981:       failures = g_mijia.family_snapshot.consecutive_failures;
982:     }
983:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
984: 
985:   syslog(LOG_WARNING,
986:          "[HOME][SYNC] refresh failed error=%d retained=%u failures=%u\n",
987:          error, (unsigned int)revision, failures);
988: }

990: static int mijia_fetch_family(const char *token, uint32_t generation,
991:                               char *home_name, size_t home_capacity,
992:                               unsigned int *device_count,
993:                               unsigned int *online_count)
994: {
995:   char authorization[192];
996:   const char *headers[2];
997:   struct webclient_context context;
998:   struct mijia_response_s sink;
999:   cJSON *devices;
1000:   cJSON *homes;
1001:   cJSON *scenes;
1002:   cJSON *summary;
1003:   cJSON *root = NULL;
1004:   char *response;
1005:   char url[512];
1006:   char buffer[MIJIA_HTTP_BUFFER_SIZE];
1007:   const char *primary_home;
1008:   unsigned int detail_error_count;
1009:   unsigned int generated_at;
1010:   unsigned int home_count;
1011:   unsigned int room_count;
1012:   unsigned int scene_count;
1013:   unsigned int server_revision;
1014:   struct home_panel_family_model_s *parsed_model = NULL;
1015:   int ret = -ENOMEM;
1016: 
1017:   /* The model is ~118 KiB.  Both full sync and delta merge run inside the
1018:    * single mijia_worker thread, so a reused scratch buffer avoids a repeated
1019:    * large malloc/free cycle on every long poll change and keeps the heap
1020:    * free of fragmentation.
1021:    */
1022: 
1023:   static struct home_panel_family_model_s g_sync_model;
1024: 
1025:   response = malloc(CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_MAX_RESPONSE);
1026:   if (response == NULL)
1027:     {
1028:       return -ENOMEM;
1029:     }
1030: 
1031:   memset(&context, 0, sizeof(context));
1032:   memset(&sink, 0, sizeof(sink));
1033: 
1034:   snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s/api/sync",
1035:            CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL);
1036:   snprintf(authorization, sizeof(authorization),
1037:            "Authorization: Bearer %s", token);
1038:   headers[0] = authorization;
1039:   headers[1] = "Connection: close";
1040:   sink.data = response;
1041:   sink.capacity = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_MAX_RESPONSE;
1042:   response[0] = '\0';
1043: 
1044:   webclient_set_defaults(&context);
1045:   context.method = "GET";
1046:   context.url = url;
1047:   context.buffer = buffer;
1048:   context.buflen = sizeof(buffer);
1049:   context.headers = headers;
1050:   context.nheaders = 2;
1051:   context.sink_callback = mijia_response_sink;
1052:   context.sink_callback_arg = &sink;
1053:   context.timeout_sec = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_TIMEOUT;
1054:   ret = webclient_perform(&context);
1055:   if (ret < 0 || context.http_status < 200 || context.http_status >= 300)
1056:     {
1057:       ret = ret < 0 ? ret :
1058:             context.http_status == 423 ? -EACCES : -EPROTO;
1059:       goto out;
1060:     }
1061: 
1062:   root = cJSON_Parse(response);
1063:   summary = root == NULL ? NULL :
1064:             cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "summary");
1065:   homes = root == NULL ? NULL :
1066:           cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "homes");
1067:   devices = root == NULL ? NULL :
1068:             cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "devices");
1069:   scenes = root == NULL ? NULL :
1070:            cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "scenes");
1071:   if (!cJSON_IsObject(summary) || !cJSON_IsArray(homes) ||
1072:       !cJSON_IsArray(devices) || !cJSON_IsArray(scenes) ||
1073:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "home_count", &home_count) ||
1074:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "room_count", &room_count) ||
1075:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "device_count", device_count) ||
1076:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "online_count", online_count) ||
1077:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "scene_count", &scene_count) ||
1078:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "detail_error_count",
1079:                        &detail_error_count) ||
1080:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "generated_at", &generated_at) ||
1081:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "sync_revision", &server_revision) ||
1082:       *device_count != (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(devices) ||
1083:       home_count != (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(homes) ||
1084:       scene_count != (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(scenes) ||
1085:       *online_count > *device_count)
1086:     {
1087:       ret = -EBADMSG;
1088:       goto out;
1089:     }
1090: 
1091:   primary_home = mijia_json_string(summary, "primary_home_name");
1092:   mijia_copy_string(home_name, home_capacity, primary_home);
1093: 
1094:   /* Parsing the full family response is intentionally done in this
1095:    * low-priority worker.  The LVGL thread only copies the compact model,
1096:    * so a cloud update cannot stall input while cJSON walks the payload.
1097:    */
1098: 
1099:   parsed_model = &g_sync_model;
1100:   memset(parsed_model, 0, sizeof(*parsed_model));
1101: 
1102:   ret = home_panel_mijia_model_parse(response, 0, parsed_model);
1103:   if (ret < 0)
1104:     {
1105:       goto out;
1106:     }
1107: 
1108:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
1109:   if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation)
1110:     {
1111:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1112:       ret = -ECANCELED;
1113:       goto out;
1114:     }
1115: 
1116:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision = ++g_mijia.next_family_revision;
1117:   parsed_model->revision = g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision;
1118:   memcpy(&g_mijia.family_model, parsed_model, sizeof(*parsed_model));
1119:   g_mijia.family_model_valid = true;
1120:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision = server_revision;
1121:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.generated_at = generated_at;
1122:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.json_size = sink.length;
1123:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.home_count = home_count;
1124:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.room_count = parsed_model->room_count;
1125:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.device_count = parsed_model->device_count;
1126:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.online_count = parsed_model->online_count;
1127:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.scene_count = parsed_model->scene_count;
1128:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.detail_error_count = detail_error_count;
1129:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.consecutive_failures = 0;
1130:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.stale = false;
1131:   syslog(LOG_INFO,
1132:          "[HOME][SYNC] revision=%u server=%u bytes=%u homes=%u rooms=%u "
1133:          "devices=%u online=%u scenes=%u detail_errors=%u\n",
1134:          (unsigned int)g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision,
1135:          server_revision, (unsigned int)sink.length, home_count, room_count,
1136:          parsed_model->device_count, parsed_model->online_count,
1137:          parsed_model->scene_count, detail_error_count);
1138:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1139:   ret = 0;
1140: 
1141: out:
1142:   if (ret < 0)
1143:     {
1144:       syslog(LOG_WARNING,
1145:              "[HOME][SYNC] request failed ret=%d status=%u bytes=%u\n",
1146:              ret, context.http_status, (unsigned int)sink.length);
1147:     }
1148: 
1149:   cJSON_Delete(root);
1150:   free(response);
1151:   return ret;
1152: }

1154: static int mijia_wait_for_changes(const char *token, uint32_t generation,
1155:                                   uint32_t after, bool *changed,
1156:                                   bool *full_resync)
1157: {
1158:   char authorization[192];
1159:   const char *headers[2];
1160:   struct webclient_context context;
1161:   struct mijia_response_s sink;
1162:   cJSON *changes;
1163:   cJSON *item;
1164:   cJSON *params;
1165:   cJSON *root = NULL;
1166:   char *response;
1167:   char url[512];
1168:   char buffer[MIJIA_HTTP_BUFFER_SIZE];
1169:   const char *method;
1170:   const char *did;
1171:   unsigned int base_revision;
1172:   unsigned int generated_at;
1173:   unsigned int online_changes = 0;
1174:   unsigned int property_changes = 0;
1175:   unsigned int revision;
1176:   unsigned int working_device_count;
1177:   unsigned int working_online_count;
1178:   uint32_t working_model_revision;
1179:   int online_count_delta = 0;
1180:   bool model_changed = false;
1181:   bool resync_required;
1182:   bool server_stale;
1183:   struct home_panel_family_model_s *working_model = NULL;
1184:   int length;
1185:   int ret = -ENOMEM;
1186: 
1187:   /* Reused by the worker thread for the delta merge; the scratch model is
1188:    * 118 KiB and would otherwise be malloc'd and freed on every poll change.
1189:    */
1190: 
1191:   static struct home_panel_family_model_s g_sync_working_model;
1192: 
1193:   *changed = false;
1194:   *full_resync = false;
1195:   response = malloc(MIJIA_DELTA_RESPONSE_SIZE);
1196:   if (response == NULL)
1197:     {
1198:       return -ENOMEM;
1199:     }
1200: 
1201:   memset(&context, 0, sizeof(context));
1202:   memset(&sink, 0, sizeof(sink));
1203:   length = snprintf(url, sizeof(url),
1204:                     "%s/api/sync/changes?after=%u&timeout=8",
1205:                     CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL,
1206:                     (unsigned int)after);
1207:   if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(url))
1208:     {
1209:       ret = -ENAMETOOLONG;
1210:       goto out;
1211:     }
1212: 
1213:   snprintf(authorization, sizeof(authorization),
1214:            "Authorization: Bearer %s", token);
1215:   headers[0] = authorization;
1216:   headers[1] = "Connection: close";
1217:   sink.data = response;
1218:   sink.capacity = MIJIA_DELTA_RESPONSE_SIZE;
1219:   response[0] = '\0';
1220: 
1221:   webclient_set_defaults(&context);
1222:   context.method = "GET";
1223:   context.url = url;
1224:   context.buffer = buffer;
1225:   context.buflen = sizeof(buffer);
1226:   context.headers = headers;
1227:   context.nheaders = 2;
1228:   context.sink_callback = mijia_response_sink;
1229:   context.sink_callback_arg = &sink;
1230:   context.timeout_sec = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_TIMEOUT;
1231:   ret = webclient_perform(&context);
1232:   if (ret < 0 || context.http_status < 200 || context.http_status >= 300)
1233:     {
1234:       ret = ret < 0 ? ret :
1235:             context.http_status == 423 ? -EACCES : -EPROTO;
1236:       goto out;
1237:     }
1238: 
1239:   if (!mijia_generation_active(generation))
1240:     {
1241:       ret = -ECANCELED;
1242:       goto out;
1243:     }
1244: 
1245:   root = cJSON_Parse(response);
1246:   changes = root == NULL ? NULL :
1247:             cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "changes");
1248:   if (!cJSON_IsArray(changes) ||
1249:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "base_revision", &base_revision) ||
1250:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "revision", &revision) ||
1251:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "generated_at", &generated_at))
1252:     {
1253:       ret = -EBADMSG;
1254:       goto out;
1255:     }
1256: 
1257:   item = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "resync_required");
1258:   if (!cJSON_IsBool(item))
1259:     {
1260:       ret = -EBADMSG;
1261:       goto out;
1262:     }
1263:   resync_required = cJSON_IsTrue(item);
1264:   item = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "stale");
1265:   if (!cJSON_IsBool(item))
1266:     {
1267:       ret = -EBADMSG;
1268:       goto out;
1269:     }
1270:   server_stale = cJSON_IsTrue(item);
1271: 
1272:   if (resync_required)
1273:     {
1274:       *changed = true;
1275:       *full_resync = true;
1276:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
1277:              "[HOME][SYNC] delta gap local=%u server=%u; full resync\n",
1278:              (unsigned int)after, revision);
1279:       ret = 0;
1280:       goto out;
1281:     }
1282: 
1283:   if (revision < after || base_revision != after)
1284:     {
1285:       /* The server reset its revision counter (service restart) or the local
1286:        * base no longer matches.  A permanent error would stall family
1287:        * synchronization forever because the worker retries with the same
1288:        * base.  Fall back to a full resync instead.
1289:        */
1290: 
1291:       *changed = true;
1292:       *full_resync = true;
1293:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
1294:              "[HOME][SYNC] delta base mismatch local=%u server=%u; "
1295:              "full resync\n",
1296:              (unsigned int)after, (unsigned int)revision);
1297:       ret = 0;
1298:       goto out;
1299:     }
1300: 
1301:   cJSON_ArrayForEach(item, changes)
1302:     {
1303:       method = mijia_json_string(item, "method");
1304:       params = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(item, "params");
1305:       if (method == NULL || !cJSON_IsArray(params))
1306:         {
1307:           ret = -EBADMSG;
1308:           goto out;
1309:         }
1310:       if (strcmp(method, "properties_changed") == 0)
1311:         {
1312:           property_changes += cJSON_GetArraySize(params);
1313:         }
1314:       else if (strcmp(method, "device_online_changed") == 0)
1315:         {
1316:           online_changes += cJSON_GetArraySize(params);
1317:         }
1318:       else
1319:         {
1320:           *changed = true;
1321:           *full_resync = true;
1322:           ret = 0;
1323:           goto out;
1324:         }
1325:     }
1326: 
1327:   if (server_stale && cJSON_GetArraySize(changes) == 0)
1328:     {
1329:       ret = -EAGAIN;
1330:       goto out;
1331:     }
1332: 
1333:   if (cJSON_GetArraySize(changes) == 0)
1334:     {
1335:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
1336:       if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation ||
1337:           g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision != after)
1338:         {
1339:           pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1340:           ret = -ECANCELED;
1341:           goto out;
1342:         }
1343: 
1344:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision = revision;
1345:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.generated_at = generated_at;
1346:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.json_size = sink.length;
1347:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.consecutive_failures = 0;
1348:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.stale = false;
1349:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1350:       ret = 0;
1351:       goto out;
1352:     }
1353: 
1354:   working_model = &g_sync_working_model;
1355:   memset(working_model, 0, sizeof(*working_model));
1356: 
1357:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
1358:   if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation ||
1359:       !g_mijia.family_model_valid)
1360:     {
1361:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1362:       ret = -ECANCELED;
1363:       goto out;
1364:     }
1365: 
1366:   if (g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision != after)
1367:     {
1368:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1369:       *changed = true;
1370:       *full_resync = true;
1371:       ret = 0;
1372:       goto out;
1373:     }
1374: 
1375:   memcpy(working_model, &g_mijia.family_model, sizeof(*working_model));
1376:   working_model_revision = g_mijia.family_model.revision;
1377:   working_device_count = g_mijia.family_snapshot.device_count;
1378:   working_online_count = g_mijia.family_snapshot.online_count;
1379:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1380: 
1381:   cJSON_ArrayForEach(item, changes)
1382:     {
1383:       method = mijia_json_string(item, "method");
1384:       params = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(item, "params");
1385:       if (strcmp(method, "device_online_changed") == 0)
1386:         {
1387:           cJSON *param;
1388: 
1389:           cJSON_ArrayForEach(param, params)
1390:             {
1391:               cJSON *previous = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(
1392:                 param, "previous_value");
1393:               cJSON *value = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(param,
1394:                                                                "value");
1395:               int apply_ret;
1396: 
1397:               did = mijia_json_string(param, "did");
1398:               if (did == NULL || !cJSON_IsBool(previous) ||
1399:                   !cJSON_IsBool(value))
1400:                 {
1401:                   ret = -EBADMSG;
1402:                   goto out;
1403:                 }
1404: 
1405:               apply_ret = home_panel_mijia_model_apply_online(
1406:                 working_model, did, cJSON_IsTrue(value));
1407:               if (apply_ret == -ENOENT)
1408:                 {
1409:                   continue;
1410:                 }
1411:               if (apply_ret < 0)
1412:                 {
1413:                   ret = apply_ret;
1414:                   goto out;
1415:                 }
1416: 
1417:               if (apply_ret > 0)
1418:                 {
1419:                   if (cJSON_IsTrue(previous) != cJSON_IsTrue(value))
1420:                     {
1421:                       online_count_delta += cJSON_IsTrue(value) ? 1 : -1;
1422:                     }
1423:                   model_changed = true;
1424:                 }
1425:             }
1426:         }
1427:       else
1428:         {
1429:           cJSON *param;
1430: 
1431:           cJSON_ArrayForEach(param, params)
1432:             {
1433:               cJSON *code_item;
1434:               cJSON *value;
1435:               unsigned int siid;
1436:               unsigned int piid;
1437:               int apply_ret;
1438: 
1439:               did = mijia_json_string(param, "did");
1440:               code_item = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(param, "code");
1441:               value = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(param, "value");
1442:               if (did == NULL || !mijia_json_uint(param, "siid", &siid) ||
1443:                   !mijia_json_uint(param, "piid", &piid) ||
1444:                   siid == 0 || siid > UINT16_MAX ||
1445:                   piid == 0 || piid > UINT16_MAX ||
1446:                   !cJSON_IsNumber(code_item))
1447:                 {
1448:                   ret = -EBADMSG;
1449:                   goto out;
1450:                 }
1451: 
1452:               if (code_item->valueint != 0)
1453:                 {
1454:                   continue;
1455:                 }
1456: 
1457:               apply_ret = home_panel_mijia_model_apply_property(
1458:                 working_model, did, (uint16_t)siid,
1459:                 (uint16_t)piid, cJSON_IsBool(value), cJSON_IsTrue(value),
1460:                 cJSON_IsNumber(value),
1461:                 cJSON_IsNumber(value) ? value->valueint : 0);
1462:               if (apply_ret == -ENOENT)
1463:                 {
1464:                   continue;
1465:                 }
1466:               if (apply_ret < 0)
1467:                 {
1468:                   ret = apply_ret;
1469:                   goto out;
1470:                 }
1471: 
1472:               model_changed |= apply_ret > 0;
1473:             }
1474:         }
1475:     }
1476: 
1477:   if (online_count_delta > 0)
1478:     {
1479:       unsigned int delta = (unsigned int)online_count_delta;
1480: 
1481:       if (working_online_count <= working_device_count &&
1482:           delta <= working_device_count - working_online_count)
1483:         {
1484:           working_online_count += delta;
1485:         }
1486:     }
1487:   else if (online_count_delta < 0)
1488:     {
1489:       unsigned int delta = (unsigned int)(-online_count_delta);
1490: 
1491:       if (delta <= working_online_count)
1492:         {
1493:           working_online_count -= delta;
1494:         }
1495:     }
1496:   if (model_changed)
1497:     {
1498:       home_panel_mijia_model_refresh_rooms(working_model);
1499:     }
1500: 
1501:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
1502:   if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation ||
1503:       !g_mijia.family_model_valid ||
1504:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision != after ||
1505:       g_mijia.family_model.revision != working_model_revision)
1506:     {
1507:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1508:       *changed = true;
1509:       *full_resync = true;
1510:       ret = 0;
1511:       goto out;
1512:     }
1513: 
1514:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision = revision;
1515:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.generated_at = generated_at;
1516:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.json_size = sink.length;
1517:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.consecutive_failures = 0;
1518:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.stale = false;
1519:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.online_count = working_online_count;
1520:   if (model_changed)
1521:     {
1522:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision = ++g_mijia.next_family_revision;
1523:       working_model->revision = g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision;
1524:       memcpy(&g_mijia.family_model, working_model,
1525:              sizeof(g_mijia.family_model));
1526:     }
1527:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1528: 
1529:   *changed = model_changed;
1530:   if (model_changed)
1531:     {
1532:       g_mijia.quiet_delta_count = 0;
1533:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
1534:              "[HOME][SYNC] delta server=%u bytes=%u methods=%u "
1535:              "properties=%u online=%u\n",
1536:              revision, (unsigned int)sink.length,
1537:              (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(changes),
1538:              property_changes, online_changes);
1539:     }
1540:   else
1541:     {
1542:       g_mijia.quiet_delta_count++;
1543:       if (g_mijia.quiet_delta_count % 30 == 0)

217:                  model_string(property, "display_value"));
218:       model_property_ids(property, &observable->siid, &observable->piid);
219:       observable->notifiable = cJSON_IsTrue(notifiable);
220:       if (cJSON_IsBool(value) ||
221:           (type != NULL && strcmp(type, "bool") == 0))
222:         {
223:           observable->type = HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN;
224:           observable->has_value = true;
225:           observable->boolean_value = cJSON_IsTrue(value);
226:         }
227:       else
228:         {
229:           observable->has_value = true;

234:                          value->valuestring);
235:             }
236:           else
237:             {
238:               observable->type = HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_NUMBER;
239:               observable->value = value->valueint;
240:             }
241:         }
242:       device->observable_count++;

280:           control->boolean_value = cJSON_IsTrue(value);

283:                (type != NULL &&
284:                 (strcmp(type, "int") == 0 || strcmp(type, "uint") == 0 ||

287:           if (!cJSON_IsNumber(value))

292:           control->type = HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_NUMBER;

296:             {
297:               control->type = HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_ENUM;
298:             }
299:           else
300:             {
301:               control->has_range = model_control_range(property, control);
302:               if (!control->has_range)
303:                 {
304:                   continue;
305:                 }
306:             }
307:         }
308:       else
309:         {
310:           continue;
311:         }
312: 
313:       device->control_count++;

369:                                struct home_panel_device_s *device)

371:   cJSON *properties;
372:   cJSON *item;
373:   int value;
374: 
375:   model_copy(device->did, sizeof(device->did), model_string(object, "did"));
376:   model_copy(device->name, sizeof(device->name),
377:              model_string(object, "name"));
378:   model_copy(device->room, sizeof(device->room),
379:              model_string(object, "room_name"));
380:   model_copy(device->model, sizeof(device->model),
381:              model_string(object, "model"));
382:   model_copy(device->type, sizeof(device->type),
383:              model_string(object, "device_type"));
384:   item = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(object, "isOnline");
385:   device->online = cJSON_IsTrue(item);
386: 
387:   properties = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(object, "properties");
388:   if (!cJSON_IsArray(properties))
389:     {
390:       return;
391:     }
392: 
393:   item = model_property(properties, "on");
394:   device->has_power = model_boolean(item, &device->power);
395:   model_property_ids(item, &device->power_siid, &device->power_piid);
396:   device->power_writable = model_writable(item);
397: 
398:   item = model_property(properties, "brightness");
399:   model_property_ids(item, &device->brightness_siid,
400:                      &device->brightness_piid);
401:   if (model_number(item, &value))
402:     {
403:       device->has_brightness = true;
404:       device->brightness = (int)value;
405:       model_brightness_range(item, device);
406:     }
407: 
408:   item = model_property(properties, "temperature");
409:   model_property_ids(item, &device->temperature_siid,
410:                      &device->temperature_piid);
411:   if (model_number(item, &value))
412:     {
413:       device->has_temperature = true;
414:       device->temperature = value;
415:     }
416: 
417:   item = model_property(properties, "relative-humidity");
418:   model_property_ids(item, &device->humidity_siid,
419:                      &device->humidity_piid);
420:   if (model_number(item, &value))
421:     {
422:       device->has_humidity = true;
423:       device->humidity = value;
424:     }
425: 
426:   item = model_property(properties, "battery-level");
427:   model_property_ids(item, &device->battery_siid,
428:                      &device->battery_piid);
429:   if (model_number(item, &value))
430:     {
431:       device->has_battery = true;
432:       device->battery = (int)value;
433:     }
434: 
435:   model_parse_observables(properties, device);
436:   model_parse_controls(properties, device);
437:   model_parse_actions(cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(object, "actions"),
438:                       device);

527: int home_panel_mijia_model_apply_property(
528:   struct home_panel_family_model_s *model, const char *did,
529:   uint16_t siid, uint16_t piid, bool is_boolean, bool boolean_value,
530:   bool is_number, int number_value)
531: {
532:   struct home_panel_device_s *device = NULL;
533:   int *number_target = NULL;
534:   bool *has_target = NULL;
535:   bool control_matched = false;
536:   bool observable_matched = false;
537:   bool changed = false;
538:   unsigned int index;
539: 
540:   for (index = 0; index < model->device_count; index++)
541:     {
542:       if (strcmp(model->devices[index].did, did) == 0)
543:         {
544:           device = &model->devices[index];
545:           break;
546:         }
547:     }
548: 
549:   if (device == NULL)
550:     {
551:       return -ENOENT;
552:     }
553: 
554:   for (index = 0; index < device->observable_count; index++)
555:     {
556:       struct home_panel_observable_s *observable =
557:         &device->observables[index];
558: 
559:       if (observable->siid != siid || observable->piid != piid)
560:         {
561:           continue;
562:         }
563: 
564:       observable_matched = true;
565:       if (observable->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN)
566:         {
567:           if (!is_boolean)
568:             {
569:               return -EBADMSG;
570:             }
571:           if (!observable->has_value ||
572:               observable->boolean_value != boolean_value)
573:             {
574:               observable->has_value = true;
575:               observable->boolean_value = boolean_value;
576:               changed = true;
577:             }
578:         }
579:       else
580:         {
581:           if (!is_number)
582:             {
583:               return -EBADMSG;
584:             }
585:           if (!observable->has_value ||
586:               observable->value != number_value)
587:             {
588:               observable->has_value = true;
589:               observable->value = number_value;
590:               changed = true;
591:             }
592:         }
593:       break;
594:     }
595: 
596:   for (index = 0; index < device->control_count; index++)
597:     {
598:       struct home_panel_control_s *control = &device->controls[index];
599: 
600:       if (control->siid != siid || control->piid != piid)
601:         {
602:           continue;
603:         }
604: 
605:       control_matched = true;
606:       if (control->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN)
607:         {
608:           if (!is_boolean)
609:             {
610:               return -EBADMSG;
611:             }
612: 
613:           if (!control->has_value ||
614:               control->boolean_value != boolean_value)
615:             {
616:               control->has_value = true;
617:               control->boolean_value = boolean_value;
618:               changed = true;
619:             }
620:         }
621:       else
622:         {
623:           if (!is_number)
624:             {
625:               return -EBADMSG;
626:             }
627: 
628:           if (!control->has_value || control->value != number_value)
629:             {
630:               control->has_value = true;
631:               control->value = number_value;
632:               changed = true;
633:             }
634:         }
635:       break;
636:     }
637: 
638:   if (device->power_siid == siid && device->power_piid == piid)
639:     {
640:       if (!is_boolean)
641:         {
642:           return -EBADMSG;
643:         }
644: 
645:       if (!device->has_power || device->power != boolean_value)
646:         {
647:           device->has_power = true;
648:           device->power = boolean_value;
649:           changed = true;
650:         }
651:       return changed ? 1 : 0;
652:     }
653: 
654:   if (device->brightness_siid == siid && device->brightness_piid == piid)
655:     {
656:       has_target = &device->has_brightness;
657:       number_target = &device->brightness;
658:     }
659:   else if (device->temperature_siid == siid &&
660:            device->temperature_piid == piid)
661:     {
662:       has_target = &device->has_temperature;
663:       number_target = &device->temperature;
664:     }
665:   else if (device->humidity_siid == siid && device->humidity_piid == piid)
666:     {
667:       has_target = &device->has_humidity;
668:       number_target = &device->humidity;
669:     }
670:   else if (device->battery_siid == siid && device->battery_piid == piid)
671:     {
672:       has_target = &device->has_battery;
673:       number_target = &device->battery;
674:     }
675:   else
676:     {
677:       return control_matched || observable_matched ?
678:              (changed ? 1 : 0) : -ENOENT;
679:     }
680: 
681:   if (!is_number)
682:     {
683:       return -EBADMSG;
684:     }
685: 
686:   if (!*has_target || *number_target != number_value)
687:     {
688:       *has_target = true;
689:       *number_target = number_value;
690:       changed = true;
691:     }
692: 
693:   return changed ? 1 : 0;
694: }

696: int home_panel_mijia_model_parse(const char *json, uint32_t revision,
697:                                  struct home_panel_family_model_s *model)
698: {
699:   cJSON *devices;
700:   cJSON *homes;
701:   cJSON *object;
702:   cJSON *protocol;
703:   cJSON *root;
704:   cJSON *rooms;
705:   cJSON *scenes;
706: 
707:   if (json == NULL || model == NULL)
708:     {
709:       return -EINVAL;
710:     }
711: 
712:   root = cJSON_Parse(json);
713:   if (root == NULL)
714:     {
715:       return -EBADMSG;
716:     }
717: 
718:   memset(model, 0, sizeof(*model));
719:   model->revision = revision;
720:   protocol = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "protocol");
721:   model_copy(model->event_source, sizeof(model->event_source),
722:              model_string(protocol, "event_source"));
723:   object = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(protocol, "mqtt_connected");
724:   model->mqtt_connected = cJSON_IsTrue(object);
725: 
726:   devices = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "devices");
727:   homes = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "homes");
728:   scenes = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "scenes");
729:   if (!cJSON_IsArray(devices) || !cJSON_IsArray(homes) ||
730:       !cJSON_IsArray(scenes))
731:     {
732:       cJSON_Delete(root);
733:       return -EBADMSG;
734:     }
735: 
736:   cJSON_ArrayForEach(object, devices)
737:     {
738:       struct home_panel_device_s *device;
739: 
740:       if (model->device_count >= HOME_PANEL_MAX_DEVICES)
741:         {
742:           break;
743:         }
744: 
745:       device = &model->devices[model->device_count++];
746:       model_parse_device(object, device);
747:       model->online_count += device->online ? 1 : 0;
748:     }
749: 
750:   cJSON_ArrayForEach(object, homes)
751:     {
752:       cJSON *room;
753: 
754:       rooms = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(object, "rooms");
755:       if (!cJSON_IsArray(rooms))
756:         {
757:           continue;
758:         }
759: 
760:       cJSON_ArrayForEach(room, rooms)
761:         {
762:           struct home_panel_room_s *target;
763:           cJSON *dids;
764: 
765:           if (model->room_count >= HOME_PANEL_MAX_ROOMS)
766:             {
767:               break;
768:             }
769: 
770:           target = &model->rooms[model->room_count++];
771:           model_copy(target->name, sizeof(target->name),
772:                      model_string(room, "name"));
773:           dids = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(room, "dids");
774:           target->device_count = cJSON_IsArray(dids) ?
775:                                  cJSON_GetArraySize(dids) : 0;
776:         }
777:     }
778: 
779:   home_panel_mijia_model_refresh_rooms(model);
780: 
781:   cJSON_ArrayForEach(object, scenes)
782:     {
783:       struct home_panel_scene_s *scene;
784: 
785:       if (model->scene_count >= HOME_PANEL_MAX_SCENES)
786:         {
787:           break;
788:         }
789: 
790:       scene = &model->scenes[model->scene_count++];
791:       model_copy(scene->id, sizeof(scene->id),
792:                  model_string(object, "scene_id"));
793:       model_copy(scene->name, sizeof(scene->name),
794:                  model_string(object, "name"));
795:     }
796: 
797:   cJSON_Delete(root);
798:   return 0;
799: }

457:   /* Confidence is a percentage; clamp the weighted sum so the UI and the
458:    * cloud analysis request never observe an out-of-range value.
459:    */
460: 
461:   return score > 100 ? 100 : score;
462: }

464: static bool proactive_routine_ready(
465:   const struct proactive_routine_record_s *routine)
466: {
467:   unsigned int minimum = routine->trigger_device_hash == 0 ?
468:                          PROACTIVE_MIN_TIME_DAYS :
469:                          PROACTIVE_MIN_EVENT_OCCURRENCES;
470: 
471:   return (routine->flags & ROUTINE_FLAG_ACTIVE) != 0 &&
472:          routine->observation_count >= minimum &&
473:          proactive_routine_confidence(routine) >=
474:            PROACTIVE_ROUTINE_THRESHOLD;

477: static bool proactive_routine_time_matches(
478:   const struct proactive_routine_record_s *routine,
479:   unsigned int minute_of_day)
480: {
481:   unsigned int window;
482: 
483:   if (routine->trigger_device_hash != 0 &&
484:       routine->observation_count >= 10 &&
485:       routine->accepted_count >= 3)
486:     {
487:       return true;
488:     }
489: 
490:   window = 120;
491:   if (routine->observation_count > 2)
492:     {
493:       unsigned int reduction = (routine->observation_count - 2) * 10u;
494: 
495:       window = reduction >= 90 ? 30 : 120 - reduction;
496:     }
497:   if (routine->mean_deviation_minutes > window)
498:     {
499:       window = routine->mean_deviation_minutes;
500:     }
501:   if (window > 180)
502:     {
503:       window = 180;
504:     }
505: 
506:   return proactive_minute_distance(
507:            minute_of_day, routine->mean_shifted_minute %
508:                           (24u * 60u)) <= window;
509: }

511: static int proactive_trigger_value(
512:   enum home_proactive_event_kind_e kind, int value)
513: {
514:   int64_t extended = value;
515:   int64_t magnitude;
516:   int64_t step;
517: 
518:   if (kind != HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_NUMBER)
519:     {
520:       return value;
521:     }
522: 
523:   magnitude = extended < 0 ? -extended : extended;
524:   step = magnitude <= 100 ? 5 : magnitude <= 1000 ? 10 : 50;
525:   return (int)(extended >= 0 ?
526:                ((extended + step / 2) / step) * step :
527:                ((extended - step / 2) / step) * step);
528: }

566:         {

582: static int proactive_allocate_routine(void)
583: {
584:   unsigned int index;
585:   unsigned int weakest = 0;
586:   unsigned int weakest_score = UINT32_MAX;
587: 
588:   if (g_proactive.profile.routine_count < PROACTIVE_MAX_ROUTINES)
589:     {
590:       index = g_proactive.profile.routine_count++;
591:       memset(&g_proactive.profile.routines[index], 0,
592:              sizeof(g_proactive.profile.routines[index]));
593:       g_proactive.profile.routines[index].routine_id =
594:         g_proactive.profile.next_routine_id++;
595:       if (g_proactive.profile.next_routine_id == 0)
596:         {
597:           g_proactive.profile.next_routine_id = 1;
598:         }
599:       return (int)index;
600:     }
601: 
602:   for (index = 0; index < PROACTIVE_MAX_ROUTINES; index++)
603:     {
604:       const struct proactive_routine_record_s *routine =
605:         &g_proactive.profile.routines[index];
606:       unsigned int score;
607: 
608:       if ((routine->flags & ROUTINE_FLAG_AUTOMATION) != 0)
609:         {
610:           continue;
611:         }
612:       score = proactive_routine_confidence(routine);
613:       if (score < weakest_score)
614:         {
615:           weakest = index;
616:           weakest_score = score;
617:         }
618:     }
619: 
620:   if (weakest_score == UINT32_MAX)
621:     {
622:       return -1;
623:     }
624:   memset(&g_proactive.profile.routines[weakest], 0,
625:          sizeof(g_proactive.profile.routines[weakest]));
626:   g_proactive.profile.routines[weakest].routine_id =
627:     g_proactive.profile.next_routine_id++;
628:   if (g_proactive.profile.next_routine_id == 0)
629:     {
630:       g_proactive.profile.next_routine_id = 1;
631:     }
632:   return (int)weakest;
633: }

635: static void proactive_update_average(uint16_t *average,
636:                                      uint16_t sample,
637:                                      uint16_t count)
638: {
639:   int difference;
640:   int next;
641: 
642:   if (count <= 1)
643:     {
644:       *average = sample;
645:       return;
646:     }
647:   /* Keep a finite memory after warm-up so a changed household habit can
648:    * converge again instead of being pinned forever by old observations.
649:    */
650: 
651:   if (count > PROACTIVE_ADAPTIVE_WINDOW)
652:     {
653:       count = PROACTIVE_ADAPTIVE_WINDOW;
654:     }
655:   difference = (int)sample - (int)*average;
656:   next = (int)*average + difference / (int)count;
657:   if (next < 0)
658:     {
659:       next = 0;
660:     }
661:   else if (next > UINT16_MAX)
662:     {
663:       next = UINT16_MAX;
664:     }
665:   *average = (uint16_t)next;
666: }

668: static void proactive_learn_routine(
669:   const struct home_proactive_event_s *trigger,
670:   const struct home_proactive_event_s *action)
671: {
672:   struct proactive_routine_record_s *routine;
673:   unsigned int shifted;
674:   unsigned int deviation;
675:   unsigned int delay_seconds = 0;
676:   int index;
677: 
678:   index = proactive_find_routine(trigger, action);
679:   if (index < 0)
680:     {
681:       index = proactive_allocate_routine();
682:       if (index < 0)
683:         {
684:           return;
685:         }
686: 
687:       routine = &g_proactive.profile.routines[index];
688:       routine->flags = ROUTINE_FLAG_ACTIVE;
689:       routine->action_device_hash = action->device_hash;
690:       routine->action_siid = action->siid;
691:       routine->action_piid = action->piid;
692:       routine->action_kind = (uint8_t)action->kind;
693:       routine->action_value = action->value;
694:       if (trigger != NULL)
695:         {
696:           routine->trigger_device_hash = trigger->device_hash;
697:           routine->trigger_siid = trigger->siid;
698:           routine->trigger_piid = trigger->piid;
699:           routine->trigger_kind = (uint8_t)trigger->kind;
700:           routine->trigger_value =
701:             proactive_trigger_value(trigger->kind, trigger->value);
702:         }
703:     }
704:   else
705:     {
706:       routine = &g_proactive.profile.routines[index];
707:     }
708: 
709:   if (trigger == NULL &&
710:       routine->last_observation_day == action->day_ordinal)
711:     {
712:       return;
713:     }
714: 
715:   if (g_proactive.profile.last_learning_day != action->day_ordinal)
716:     {
717:       g_proactive.profile.history_days++;
718:       g_proactive.profile.last_learning_day = action->day_ordinal;
719:     }
720:   if (routine->observation_count < UINT16_MAX)
721:     {
722:       routine->observation_count++;
723:     }
724:   routine->last_observation_day = action->day_ordinal;
725:   shifted = proactive_shift_sleep_minute(action->minute_of_day);
726:   deviation = routine->observation_count <= 1 ? 0 :
727:               proactive_minute_distance(
728:                 action->minute_of_day,
729:                 routine->mean_shifted_minute % (24u * 60u));
730:   proactive_update_average(&routine->mean_shifted_minute,
731:                            (uint16_t)shifted,
732:                            routine->observation_count);
733:   proactive_update_average(&routine->mean_deviation_minutes,
734:                            (uint16_t)deviation,
735:                            routine->observation_count);
736: 
737:   if (trigger != NULL)
738:     {
739:       delay_seconds = (uint32_t)(action->now_ms - trigger->now_ms) / 1000u;
740:       if (delay_seconds > 3600)
741:         {
742:           delay_seconds = 3600;
743:         }
744:       proactive_update_average(&routine->mean_delay_seconds,
745:                                (uint16_t)delay_seconds,
746:                                routine->observation_count);
747:     }
748:   proactive_mark_routine_updated(index, HOME_PROACTIVE_UPDATE_OBSERVATION);
749: }

779: static void proactive_activate_routine(unsigned int index,
780:                                        uint32_t now_ms)
781: {

785:     {

789:   if (!proactive_routine_ready(routine) ||

791:       !proactive_routine_time_matches(routine,
792:                                       g_proactive.context.minute_of_day))

800:   if (routine->mean_delay_seconds == 0)
801:     {
802:       g_proactive.active_routine = (int)index;
803:       g_proactive.pending_routine = -1;

808: static unsigned int proactive_confidence(void)
809: {
810:   unsigned int count = g_proactive.profile.feedback_count;
811:   unsigned int evidence;
812:   unsigned int acceptance;
813:   unsigned int score;
814: 
815:   if (count == 0)
816:     {
817:       return 15;
818:     }
819: 
820:   evidence = count > 6 ? 40 : count * 6;
821:   acceptance = g_proactive.profile.accepted_count * 45 / count;
822:   score = 10 + evidence + acceptance;
823:   return score > 95 ? 95 : score;
824: }

838: static bool proactive_should_suggest(void)
839: {
840:   unsigned int confidence;
841:   unsigned int preferred;
842:   unsigned int window;
843: 
844:   if (g_proactive.active_routine >= 0 &&
845:       (unsigned int)g_proactive.active_routine <
846:         g_proactive.profile.routine_count)
847:     {
848:       const struct proactive_routine_record_s *routine =
849:         &g_proactive.profile.routines[g_proactive.active_routine];
850: 
851:       return g_proactive.context.clock_valid &&
852:              g_proactive.context.day_ordinal != 0 &&
853:              proactive_routine_ready(routine) &&
854:              routine->last_executed_day !=
855:                g_proactive.context.day_ordinal;
856:     }
857: 
858:   if (g_proactive.context.lights_on == 0 ||
859:       !g_proactive.context.target_available)
860:     {
861:       return false;
862:     }
863:   if (g_proactive.suggestion_dismissed)
864:     {
865:       return false;
866:     }
867:   if (g_proactive.profile.last_observation_day != 0 &&
868:       g_proactive.context.day_ordinal != 0 &&
869:       g_proactive.context.day_ordinal <
870:       g_proactive.profile.last_observation_day +
871:       g_proactive.profile.reminder_cooldown_days)
872:     {
873:       return false;
874:     }
875:   if (g_proactive.mode == HOME_PROACTIVE_REPLAY)
876:     {
877:       return false;
878:     }
879:   if (g_proactive.mode == HOME_PROACTIVE_DEMO_READY)
880:     {
881:       return true;
882:     }
883:   if (!g_proactive.context.clock_valid ||
884:       g_proactive.context.day_ordinal == 0)
885:     {
886:       return false;
887:     }
888: 
889:   confidence = proactive_confidence();
890:   if (g_proactive.profile.feedback_count >= 4 && confidence < 45)
891:     {
892:       return false;
893:     }
894: 
895:   preferred = proactive_preferred_minute();
896:   window = PROACTIVE_COLD_WINDOW_MINUTES;
897:   if (g_proactive.profile.sleep_sample_count > 0)
898:     {
899:       unsigned int reduction =
900:         g_proactive.profile.sleep_sample_count > 6 ? 30 :
901:         g_proactive.profile.sleep_sample_count * 5;
902: 
903:       window = PROACTIVE_COLD_WINDOW_MINUTES - reduction;
904:       if (window < PROACTIVE_MIN_WINDOW_MINUTES)
905:         {
906:           window = PROACTIVE_MIN_WINDOW_MINUTES;
907:         }
908:     }
909: 
910:   return proactive_minute_distance(g_proactive.context.minute_of_day,
911:                                    preferred) <= window;
912: }

914: static bool proactive_apply_feedback(
915:   uint32_t day_ordinal, unsigned int minute_of_day,
916:   enum home_proactive_feedback_e feedback)
917: {
918:   if (feedback < HOME_PROACTIVE_ACCEPT ||
919:       feedback > HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION || day_ordinal == 0)
920:     {
921:       return false;
922:     }
923:   if (g_proactive.profile.last_observation_day != 0 &&
924:       day_ordinal < g_proactive.profile.last_observation_day)
925:     {
926:       return false;
927:     }
928: 
929:   if (g_proactive.profile.feedback_count >= PROACTIVE_MAX_FEEDBACK)
930:     {
931:       g_proactive.profile.accepted_count /= 2;
932:       g_proactive.profile.ignored_count /= 2;
933:       g_proactive.profile.feedback_count =
934:         g_proactive.profile.accepted_count +
935:         g_proactive.profile.ignored_count;
936:       g_proactive.profile.history_days /= 2;
937:       if (g_proactive.profile.history_days >
938:           g_proactive.profile.feedback_count)
939:         {
940:           g_proactive.profile.history_days =
941:             g_proactive.profile.feedback_count;
942:         }
943:     }
944: 
945:   if (day_ordinal != g_proactive.profile.last_learning_day)
946:     {
947:       g_proactive.profile.history_days++;
948:       g_proactive.profile.last_learning_day = day_ordinal;
949:     }
950:   g_proactive.profile.feedback_count++;
951:   g_proactive.profile.last_observation_day = day_ordinal;
952: 
953:   if (feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_ACCEPT ||
954:       feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION)
955:     {
956:       if (g_proactive.profile.sleep_sample_count >= PROACTIVE_MAX_SAMPLES)
957:         {
958:           g_proactive.profile.sleep_sample_count /= 2;
959:           g_proactive.profile.sleep_shifted_minute_total /= 2;
960:         }
961:       g_proactive.profile.accepted_count++;
962:       g_proactive.profile.sleep_sample_count++;
963:       g_proactive.profile.sleep_shifted_minute_total +=
964:         proactive_shift_sleep_minute(minute_of_day);
965:       if (g_proactive.profile.reminder_cooldown_days > 1)
966:         {
967:           g_proactive.profile.reminder_cooldown_days--;
968:         }
969:     }
970:   else
971:     {
972:       g_proactive.profile.ignored_count++;
973:       if (feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_LESS_OFTEN &&
974:           g_proactive.profile.reminder_cooldown_days < 7)
975:         {
976:           g_proactive.profile.reminder_cooldown_days++;
977:         }
978:     }
979: 
980:   return true;
981: }
