1036: void home_proactive_observe_event(
1037:   const struct home_proactive_event_s *event)
1038: {
1039:   unsigned int index;
1040:   unsigned int linked_triggers = 0;
1041: 
1042:   if (event == NULL || event->device_hash == 0 ||
1043:       event->day_ordinal == 0 ||
1044:       event->minute_of_day >= 24u * 60u ||
1045:       event->kind > HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_ONLINE)
1046:     {
1047:       return;
1048:     }
1049: 
1050:   if (!event->self_generated && proactive_event_duplicate(event))
1051:     {
1052:       return;
1053:     }
1054: 
1055:   g_proactive.context.day_ordinal = event->day_ordinal;
1056:   g_proactive.context.minute_of_day = event->minute_of_day;
1057:   if (!event->self_generated)
1058:     {
1059:       int best = -1;
1060:       unsigned int best_score = 0;
1061: 
1062:       for (index = 0; index < g_proactive.profile.routine_count; index++)
1063:         {
1064:           struct proactive_routine_record_s *routine =
1065:             &g_proactive.profile.routines[index];
1066:           unsigned int score;
1067: 
1068:           if (!proactive_event_matches_trigger(event, routine) ||
1069:               !proactive_routine_ready(routine))
1070:             {
1071:               continue;
1072:             }
1073:           score = proactive_routine_confidence(routine);
1074:           if (best < 0 || score > best_score)
1075:             {
1076:               best = (int)index;
1077:               best_score = score;
1078:             }
1079:         }
1080:       if (best >= 0)
1081:         {
1082:           proactive_activate_routine((unsigned int)best, event->now_ms);
1083:         }
1084:     }
1085: 
1086:   if (!event->self_generated && g_proactive.active_routine >= 0 &&
1087:       (unsigned int)g_proactive.active_routine <
1088:         g_proactive.profile.routine_count &&
1089:       proactive_event_matches_action(
1090:         event, &g_proactive.profile.routines[g_proactive.active_routine]))
1091:     {
1092:       struct proactive_routine_record_s *routine =
1093:         &g_proactive.profile.routines[g_proactive.active_routine];
1094: 
1095:       if (routine->accepted_count < UINT16_MAX)
1096:         {
1097:           routine->accepted_count++;
1098:         }
1099:       routine->consecutive_rejections = 0;
1100:       if (g_proactive.profile.accepted_count < UINT32_MAX)
1101:         {
1102:           g_proactive.profile.accepted_count++;
1103:           g_proactive.profile.feedback_count++;
1104:         }
1105:       routine->last_executed_day = event->day_ordinal;
1106:       proactive_mark_routine_updated(
1107:         g_proactive.active_routine, HOME_PROACTIVE_UPDATE_ACCEPTED);
1108:       g_proactive.active_routine = -1;
1109:       g_proactive.pending_routine = -1;
1110:       proactive_bump_revision();
1111:     }
1112: 
1113:   if (event->writable && !event->self_generated)
1114:     {
1115:       proactive_learn_routine(NULL, event);
1116:       for (index = g_proactive.recent_event_count; index > 0; index--)
1117:         {
1118:           const struct home_proactive_event_s *candidate =
1119:             &g_proactive.recent_events[index - 1];
1120:           unsigned int newer;
1121:           bool duplicate = false;
1122: 
1123:           if ((uint32_t)(event->now_ms - candidate->now_ms) >
1124:                 PROACTIVE_TRIGGER_WINDOW_MS)
1125:             {
1126:               break;
1127:             }
1128:           if ((candidate->device_hash == event->device_hash &&
1129:                candidate->siid == event->siid &&
1130:                candidate->piid == event->piid) ||
1131:               candidate->self_generated)
1132:             {
1133:               continue;
1134:             }
1135: 
1136:           for (newer = index;
1137:                newer < g_proactive.recent_event_count; newer++)
1138:             {
1139:               const struct home_proactive_event_s *other =
1140:                 &g_proactive.recent_events[newer];
1141: 
1142:               if (other->device_hash == candidate->device_hash &&
1143:                   other->siid == candidate->siid &&
1144:                   other->piid == candidate->piid &&
1145:                   other->kind == candidate->kind &&
1146:                   proactive_trigger_value(other->kind, other->value) ==
1147:                     proactive_trigger_value(candidate->kind,
1148:                                             candidate->value))
1149:                 {
1150:                   duplicate = true;
1151:                   break;
1152:                 }
1153:             }
1154:           if (!duplicate)
1155:             {
1156:               proactive_learn_routine(candidate, event);
1157:               linked_triggers++;
1158:               if (linked_triggers >= PROACTIVE_MAX_TRIGGER_LINKS)
1159:                 {
1160:                   break;
1161:                 }
1162:             }
1163:         }
1164:       proactive_bump_revision();
1165:     }
1166: 
1167:   if (!event->self_generated)
1168:     {
1169:       if (g_proactive.recent_event_count == PROACTIVE_RECENT_EVENTS)
1170:         {
1171:           memmove(&g_proactive.recent_events[0],
1172:                   &g_proactive.recent_events[1],
1173:                   sizeof(g_proactive.recent_events[0]) *
1174:                   (PROACTIVE_RECENT_EVENTS - 1));
1175:           g_proactive.recent_event_count--;
1176:         }
1177:       g_proactive.recent_events[g_proactive.recent_event_count++] = *event;
1178:     }
1179: }

1219: void home_proactive_tick(uint32_t now_ms)
1220: {
1221:   unsigned int target_day;
1222:   unsigned int index;
1223: 
1224:   if (g_proactive.mode != HOME_PROACTIVE_REPLAY)
1225:     {
1226:       if (g_proactive.pending_routine >= 0 &&
1227:           (int32_t)(now_ms - g_proactive.pending_due_ms) >= 0)
1228:         {
1229:           g_proactive.active_routine = g_proactive.pending_routine;
1230:           g_proactive.pending_routine = -1;
1231:           proactive_bump_revision();
1232:         }
1233:       if (g_proactive.active_routine < 0 &&
1234:           g_proactive.pending_routine < 0 &&
1235:           g_proactive.context.clock_valid)
1236:         {
1237:           for (index = 0;
1238:                index < g_proactive.profile.routine_count; index++)
1239:             {
1240:               const struct proactive_routine_record_s *routine =
1241:                 &g_proactive.profile.routines[index];
1242: 
1243:               if (routine->trigger_device_hash == 0 &&
1244:                   proactive_routine_time_matches(
1245:                     routine, g_proactive.context.minute_of_day))
1246:                 {
1247:                   proactive_activate_routine(index, now_ms);
1248:                   if (g_proactive.active_routine >= 0 ||
1249:                       g_proactive.pending_routine >= 0)
1250:                     {
1251:                       break;
1252:                     }
1253:                 }
1254:             }
1255:         }
1256:       return;
1257:     }
1258: 
1259:   target_day = (now_ms - g_proactive.replay_started_ms) /
1260:                PROACTIVE_REPLAY_STEP_MS;
1261:   if (target_day > sizeof(g_replay_events) / sizeof(g_replay_events[0]))
1262:     {
1263:       target_day = sizeof(g_replay_events) / sizeof(g_replay_events[0]);
1264:     }
1265: 
1266:   while (g_proactive.replay_day < target_day)
1267:     {
1268:       const struct proactive_replay_event_s *event =
1269:         &g_replay_events[g_proactive.replay_day];
1270: 
1271:       proactive_apply_feedback(g_proactive.replay_day + 1,
1272:                                event->minute_of_day, event->feedback);
1273:       g_proactive.replay_day++;
1274:       proactive_bump_revision();
1275:     }
1276: 
1277:   if (g_proactive.replay_day ==
1278:       sizeof(g_replay_events) / sizeof(g_replay_events[0]))
1279:     {
1280:       g_proactive.mode = HOME_PROACTIVE_DEMO_READY;
1281:       g_proactive.context.clock_valid = true;
1282:       g_proactive.context.day_ordinal = 8;
1283:       g_proactive.context.minute_of_day = 23 * 60 + 8;
1284:       proactive_bump_revision();
1285:     }
1286: }

1288: void home_proactive_feedback(enum home_proactive_feedback_e feedback)
1289: {
1290:   if (g_proactive.active_routine >= 0 &&
1291:       (unsigned int)g_proactive.active_routine <
1292:         g_proactive.profile.routine_count)
1293:     {
1294:       struct proactive_routine_record_s *routine =
1295:         &g_proactive.profile.routines[g_proactive.active_routine];
1296: 
1297:       if (feedback < HOME_PROACTIVE_ACCEPT ||
1298:           feedback > HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION)
1299:         {
1300:           return;
1301:         }
1302:       if (feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_ACCEPT ||
1303:           feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION)
1304:         {
1305:           if (routine->accepted_count < UINT16_MAX)
1306:             {
1307:               routine->accepted_count++;
1308:             }
1309:           routine->consecutive_rejections = 0;
1310:           if (g_proactive.profile.accepted_count < UINT32_MAX)
1311:             {
1312:               g_proactive.profile.accepted_count++;
1313:             }
1314:           if (feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION)
1315:             {
1316:               routine->flags |= ROUTINE_FLAG_AUTOMATION;
1317:             }
1318:         }
1319:       else
1320:         {
1321:           if (routine->rejected_count < UINT16_MAX)
1322:             {
1323:               routine->rejected_count++;
1324:             }
1325:           if (routine->consecutive_rejections < UINT8_MAX)
1326:             {
1327:               routine->consecutive_rejections++;
1328:             }
1329:           if (g_proactive.profile.ignored_count < UINT32_MAX)
1330:             {
1331:               g_proactive.profile.ignored_count++;
1332:             }
1333:           if ((routine->flags & ROUTINE_FLAG_AUTOMATION) != 0)
1334:             {
1335:               routine->flags &= (uint8_t)~ROUTINE_FLAG_AUTOMATION;
1336:             }
1337:         }
1338:       if (g_proactive.profile.feedback_count < UINT32_MAX)
1339:         {
1340:           g_proactive.profile.feedback_count++;
1341:         }
1342:       routine->last_executed_day = g_proactive.context.day_ordinal;
1343:       proactive_mark_routine_updated(
1344:         g_proactive.active_routine,
1345:         feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_ENABLE_AUTOMATION ?
1346:           HOME_PROACTIVE_UPDATE_AUTOMATION_ENABLED :
1347:         feedback == HOME_PROACTIVE_ACCEPT ?
1348:           HOME_PROACTIVE_UPDATE_ACCEPTED :
1349:           HOME_PROACTIVE_UPDATE_REJECTED);
1350:       g_proactive.active_routine = -1;
1351:       g_proactive.pending_routine = -1;
1352:       g_proactive.automation_inflight = false;
1353:       proactive_bump_revision();
1354:       return;
1355:     }
1356: 
1357:   if (!proactive_should_suggest() ||
1358:       !proactive_apply_feedback(g_proactive.context.day_ordinal,
1359:                                 g_proactive.context.minute_of_day,
1360:                                 feedback))
1361:     {
1362:       return;
1363:     }
1364: 
1365:   g_proactive.suggestion_dismissed = true;
1366:   g_proactive.dismissed_day = g_proactive.context.day_ordinal;
1367:   proactive_bump_revision();
1368: }

632:   if (ret < 0 || *length > UINT16_MAX)
633:     {

635:       return ret < 0 ? ret : -EOVERFLOW;
636:     }
637:   record->profile_length = (uint16_t)*length;
638:   record->cloud_count = g_cloud_automation_count;
639:   memcpy(record->cloud, g_cloud_automations,

645: static void *proactive_persist_worker(void *arg)
646: {
647:   struct proactive_persist_work_s *work = arg;
648:   irqstate_t flags;
649:   int ret = board_agent_persist_write(work->data, work->length);
650: 
651:   syslog(ret == 0 ? LOG_INFO : LOG_WARNING,
652:          "[HOME][AGENT] profile persist ret=%d bytes=%u\n",
653:          ret, (unsigned int)work->length);
654:   free(work);
655:   flags = up_irq_save();
656:   g_proactive_persist_busy = false;
657:   up_irq_restore(flags);
658:   return NULL;
659: }
660: 
661: static void schedule_proactive_persist(void)
662: {
663:   struct proactive_persist_work_s *work;
664:   struct sched_param param;
665:   irqstate_t flags;
666:   pthread_attr_t attr;
667:   pthread_t thread;
668:   int ret;
669: 
670:   flags = up_irq_save();
671:   if (g_proactive_persist_busy)
672:     {
673:       g_proactive_persist_pending = true;
674:       up_irq_restore(flags);
675:       return;
676:     }
677:   g_proactive_persist_busy = true;
678:   g_proactive_persist_pending = false;
679:   up_irq_restore(flags);
680: 
681:   work = calloc(1, sizeof(*work));
682:   if (work == NULL)
683:     {
684:       ret = -ENOMEM;
685:       goto fail;
686:     }
687: 
688:   ret = build_agent_persist_record(work->data, sizeof(work->data),
689:                                    &work->length);
690:   if (ret < 0)
691:     {
692:       free(work);
693:       work = NULL;
694:       goto fail;
695:     }
696: 
697:   pthread_attr_init(&attr);
698:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, PROACTIVE_THREAD_STACK);
699:   pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attr, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
700:   pthread_attr_setinheritsched(&attr, PTHREAD_EXPLICIT_SCHED);
701:   pthread_attr_setschedpolicy(&attr, SCHED_RR);
702:   memset(&param, 0, sizeof(param));
703:   param.sched_priority = 45;
704:   pthread_attr_setschedparam(&attr, &param);
705:   ret = pthread_create(&thread, &attr, proactive_persist_worker, work);
706:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
707:   if (ret != 0)
708:     {
709:       free(work);
710:       goto fail;
711:     }
712:   return;
713: 
714: fail:
715:   flags = up_irq_save();
716:   g_proactive_persist_busy = false;
717:   g_proactive_persist_pending = true;
718:   g_proactive_persist_retry_at =
719:     lv_tick_get() + PROACTIVE_PERSIST_RETRY_MS;
720:   up_irq_restore(flags);
721:   syslog(LOG_WARNING,
722:          "[HOME][AGENT] profile worker start failed ret=%d\n", ret);
723: }

944:  * Automation signature (moved from main.c)
945:  ****************************************************************************/
946: 
947: static uint32_t compute_automation_signature(
948:   const struct home_proactive_automation_s *items,
949:   unsigned int count)
950: {
951:   uint32_t hash = 2166136261u;
952:   unsigned int index;
953: 
954:   for (index = 0; index < count; index++)
955:     {
956:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].routine_id) * 16777619u;
957:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].trigger_device_hash) * 16777619u;
958:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].action_device_hash) * 16777619u;
959:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].action_siid) * 16777619u;
960:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].action_piid) * 16777619u;
961:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].mean_minute_of_day) * 16777619u;
962:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].mean_delay_seconds) * 16777619u;
963:       hash = (hash ^ items[index].action_kind) * 16777619u;
964:       hash = (hash ^ (items[index].event_triggered ? 1u : 0u)) *
965:              16777619u;
966:       hash = (hash ^ (uint32_t)items[index].action_value) * 16777619u;
967:     }
968:   return (hash ^ count) == 0 ? 1 : (hash ^ count);
969: }

1007: static int cloud_send_next_action(void)
1008: {
1009:   while (g_cloud_execution.active &&
1010:          g_cloud_execution.action_index <
1011:            g_cloud_execution.record.action_count)
1012:     {
1013:       const struct cloud_automation_action_s *action =
1014:         &g_cloud_execution.record.actions[g_cloud_execution.action_index];
1015:       const struct home_panel_device_s *device =
1016:         cloud_find_device(action->device_hash);
1017:       const struct home_panel_control_s *control;
1018:       int current;
1019:       int ret;
1020: 
1021:       if (device == NULL || !device->online ||
1022:           !proactive_safe_action_device(device))
1023:         {
1024:           return -ENODEV;
1025:         }
1026:       control = proactive_find_control(device, action->siid, action->piid);
1027:       if (control == NULL || !proactive_safe_action_control(control) ||
1028:           !control->has_value ||
1029:           (action->value_is_boolean ?
1030:             control->type != HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN :
1031:             !cloud_number_allowed(control, action->value)))
1032:         {
1033:           return -EPERM;
1034:         }
1035:       current = control->type == HOME_PANEL_CONTROL_BOOLEAN ?
1036:                   (control->boolean_value ? 1 : 0) : control->value;
1037:       if (current == action->value)
1038:         {
1039:           g_cloud_execution.action_index++;
1040:           continue;
1041:         }
1042:       ret = action->value_is_boolean ?
1043:         home_panel_mijia_request_bool_property(
1044:           device->did, device->name, control->name,
1045:           control->siid, control->piid, action->value != 0) :
1046:         home_panel_mijia_request_number_property(
1047:           device->did, device->name, control->name,
1048:           control->siid, control->piid, action->value);
1049:       if (ret != 0)
1050:         {
1051:           return ret;
1052:         }
1053:       memset(&g_proactive_command, 0, sizeof(g_proactive_command));
1054:       g_proactive_command.device_hash = action->device_hash;
1055:       g_proactive_command.deadline_ms = lv_tick_get() + 15000u;
1056:       g_proactive_command.siid = action->siid;
1057:       g_proactive_command.piid = action->piid;
1058:       g_proactive_command.value = action->value;
1059:       g_proactive_command.kind = action->value_is_boolean ?
1060:         HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_BOOLEAN : HOME_PROACTIVE_EVENT_NUMBER;
1061:       g_proactive_command.active = true;
1062:       g_proactive_command.cloud_execution = true;
1063:       return 0;
1064:     }
1065:   if (g_cloud_execution.active)
1066:     {
1067:       cloud_finish_execution(true);
1068:     }
1069:   return 1;
1070: }

1104: {

1108:   bool changed = false;

1110:   home_panel_mijia_get_board_proposal(&proposal);
1111:   if (!proposal.valid || proposal.kind != HOME_PANEL_CLOUD_AUTOMATION ||
1112:       proposal.status != HOME_PANEL_CLOUD_PROPOSAL_PLAN_READY)
1113:     {
1114:       return;
1115:     }
1116:   if (proposal.update_revision == g_cloud_plan_handled_revision)
1117:     {
1118:       return;
1119:     }
1120:   if (!cloud_build_record(&proposal, &record, true))
1121:     {
1122:       g_cloud_plan_handled_revision = proposal.update_revision;
1123:       cloud_queue_feedback(proposal.proposal_id, "execution_failed");
1124:       snprintf(g_last_feedback_message, sizeof(g_last_feedback_message),
1125:                "服务端计划未通过板端能力与安全校验，未保存");
1126:       return;
1127:     }
1128:   for (index = 0; index < g_cloud_automation_count; index++)
1129:     {
1130:       if (g_cloud_automations[index].routine_id == record.routine_id)
1131:         {
1132:           if (memcmp(&g_cloud_automations[index], &record,
1133:                      sizeof(record)) != 0)
1134:             {
1135:               g_cloud_automations[index] = record;
1136:               changed = true;
1137:             }
1138:           break;
1139:         }
1140:     }
1141:   if (index == g_cloud_automation_count)
1142:     {
1143:       if (g_cloud_automation_count >= CLOUD_AUTOMATION_MAX)
1144:         {
1145:           g_cloud_plan_handled_revision = proposal.update_revision;
1146:           cloud_queue_feedback(proposal.proposal_id, "execution_failed");
1147:           snprintf(g_last_feedback_message, sizeof(g_last_feedback_message),
1148:                    "离线自动化已满，请先删除旧规则");
1149:           return;
1150:         }
1151:       g_cloud_automations[g_cloud_automation_count++] = record;
1152:       changed = true;
1153:     }
1154:   if (changed)
1155:     {
1156:       schedule_proactive_persist();
1157:       g_ctrl_automation_signature = 0;
1158:     }
1159:   g_cloud_plan_handled_revision = proposal.update_revision;
1160:   cloud_queue_feedback(proposal.proposal_id, "automation_saved");
1161:   snprintf(g_last_feedback_message, sizeof(g_last_feedback_message),
1162:            "多设备自动化已保存，可在断网时运行");
1163: }

1165: /****************************************************************************
1166:  * Cloud automation tick processing (moved from main.c)
1167:  ****************************************************************************/
1168: 
1169: static void process_cloud_automations(void)
1170: {
1171:   uint32_t day;
1172:   uint16_t minute;
1173:   unsigned int index;
1174: 
1175:   if (g_cloud_feedback_count > 0)
1176:     {
1177:       const struct cloud_feedback_s *feedback = &g_cloud_feedback_queue[0];
1178:       int ret = home_panel_mijia_feedback_board_proposal(
1179:         feedback->proposal_id, feedback->result);
1180:       if (ret == 0)
1181:         {
1182:           g_cloud_feedback_count--;
1183:           if (g_cloud_feedback_count > 0)
1184:             {
1185:               memmove(&g_cloud_feedback_queue[0],
1186:                       &g_cloud_feedback_queue[1],
1187:                       sizeof(g_cloud_feedback_queue[0]) *
1188:                         g_cloud_feedback_count);
1189:             }
1190:           memset(&g_cloud_feedback_queue[g_cloud_feedback_count], 0,
1191:                  sizeof(g_cloud_feedback_queue[0]));
1192:         }
1193:     }
1194:   process_cloud_proposal();
1195:   if (g_cloud_execution.active)
1196:     {
1197:       if (!g_proactive_command.active)
1198:         {
1199:           int ret = cloud_send_next_action();
1200:           if (ret < 0 && ret != -EBUSY)
1201:             {
1202:               cloud_finish_execution(false);
1203:             }
1204:         }
1205:       return;
1206:     }
1207:   if (g_proactive_command.active || !proactive_event_time(&day, &minute))
1208:     {
1209:       return;
1210:     }
1211:   for (index = 0; index < g_cloud_automation_count; index++)
1212:     {
1213:       struct cloud_automation_record_s *record =
1214:         &g_cloud_automations[index];
1215:       bool due = false;
1216: 
1217:       if (record->last_executed_day == day)
1218:         {
1219:           continue;
1220:         }
1221:       if (record->trigger_kind == HOME_PANEL_CLOUD_TRIGGER_TIME)
1222:         {
1223:           time_t now = time(NULL) + 8 * 60 * 60;
1224:           struct tm current;
1225:           unsigned int weekday;
1226: 
1227:           gmtime_r(&now, &current);
1228:           weekday = (current.tm_wday + 6) % 7;
1229:           due = (record->days_mask & (1u << weekday)) != 0 &&
1230:                 ((record->minute_of_day + record->window_minutes < 1440 &&
1231:                   minute >= record->minute_of_day &&
1232:                   minute <= record->minute_of_day +
1233:                             record->window_minutes) ||
1234:                  (record->minute_of_day + record->window_minutes >= 1440 &&
1235:                   (minute >= record->minute_of_day ||
1236:                    minute <= record->minute_of_day +
1237:                              record->window_minutes - 1440)));
1238:         }

1322:       (after.routine_count != before.routine_count ||
1323:        after.routine_observations != before.routine_observations ||

2564: static uint32_t mijia_board_hash(const char *text)
2565: {
2566:   uint32_t hash = 2166136261u;
2567:   const unsigned char *cursor = (const unsigned char *)text;
2568: 
2569:   while (cursor != NULL && *cursor != '\0')
2570:     {
2571:       hash = (hash ^ *cursor++) * 16777619u;
2572:     }
2573:   return hash == 0 ? 1 : hash;
2574: }

2576: static bool mijia_board_semantic_valid(const char *value)
2577: {
2578:   size_t index;
2579:   size_t length;
2580: 
2581:   if (value == NULL)
2582:     {
2583:       return false;
2584:     }
2585:   length = strlen(value);
2586:   if (length == 0 || length > 32)
2587:     {
2588:       return false;
2589:     }
2590:   for (index = 0; index < length; index++)
2591:     {
2592:       char ch = value[index];
2593:       if (!((ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') ||
2594:             ch == '.' || ch == '_' || ch == '-'))
2595:         {
2596:           return false;
2597:         }
2598:     }
2599:   return true;
2600: }

3108: {

3110:   struct home_panel_cloud_proposal_s proposal;
3111:   char response[MIJIA_BOARD_AGENT_RESPONSE_SIZE];
3112:   char path[128];
3113:   char *body = NULL;
3114:   cJSON *payload = NULL;
3115:   cJSON *root = NULL;
3116:   cJSON *proposal_item;
3117:   unsigned int http_status = 0;
3118:   bool clear = false;
3119:   int ret = -ENOMEM;
3120: 
3121:   response[0] = '\0';
3122:   if (request->kind == MIJIA_BOARD_AGENT_STATE)
3123:     {
3124:       body = mijia_build_board_state_body(request);
3125:       if (body == NULL)
3126:         {
3127:           goto out;
3128:         }
3129:       ret = mijia_authorized_post(request->token, "/api/agent/state",
3130:                                   body, response, sizeof(response),
3131:                                   &http_status);
3132:     }
3133:   else if (request->kind == MIJIA_BOARD_AGENT_POLL)
3134:     {
3135:       snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "/api/agent/proposal?after=%u",
3136:                (unsigned int)request->proposal_after);
3137:       ret = mijia_authorized_get(request->token, path, response,
3138:                                  sizeof(response), &http_status);
3139:     }
3140:   else
3141:     {
3142:       payload = cJSON_CreateObject();
3143:       if (payload == NULL)
3144:         {
3145:           goto out;
3146:         }
3147:       cJSON_AddStringToObject(
3148:         payload, "purpose",
3149:         request->kind == MIJIA_BOARD_AGENT_CONFIRM ?
3150:           "用户已阅读说明并同意生成离线自动化计划" :
3151:           "反馈用户选择或设备执行结果供主动智能继续学习");
3152:       cJSON_AddStringToObject(payload, "proposal_id",
3153:                              request->proposal_id);
3154:       if (request->kind == MIJIA_BOARD_AGENT_CONFIRM)
3155:         {
3156:           cJSON_AddBoolToObject(payload, "consent", true);
3157:         }
3158:       else
3159:         {
3160:           cJSON_AddStringToObject(payload, "result", request->feedback);
3161:         }
3162:       body = cJSON_PrintUnformatted(payload);
3163:       if (body == NULL)
3164:         {
3165:           goto out;
3166:         }
3167:       ret = mijia_authorized_post(
3168:         request->token,
3169:         request->kind == MIJIA_BOARD_AGENT_CONFIRM ?
3170:           "/api/agent/proposal/confirm" :
3171:           "/api/agent/proposal/feedback",
3172:         body, response, sizeof(response), &http_status);
3173:       clear = request->kind == MIJIA_BOARD_AGENT_FEEDBACK &&
3174:               (strcmp(request->feedback, "dismissed") == 0 ||
3175:                strcmp(request->feedback, "execution_succeeded") == 0 ||
3176:                strcmp(request->feedback, "execution_failed") == 0 ||
3177:                strcmp(request->feedback, "automation_saved") == 0);
3178:     }
3179:   if (ret < 0)
3180:     {
3181:       goto out;
3182:     }
3183:   root = cJSON_Parse(response);
3184:   if (root == NULL)
3185:     {
3186:       ret = -EBADMSG;
3187:       goto out;
3188:     }
3189:   if (request->kind != MIJIA_BOARD_AGENT_FEEDBACK)
3190:     {
3191:       proposal_item = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "proposal");
3192:       ret = mijia_board_parse_proposal(proposal_item, &proposal);
3193:       if (ret == -ENOENT)

3195:           ret = 0;
3196:         }
3197:       else if (ret == 0)
3198:         {
3199:           mijia_board_publish_proposal(request->generation, &proposal,
3200:                                        false);
3201:         }
3202:     }
3203:   else
3204:     {
3205:       ret = 0;
3206:       if (clear)
3207:         {
3208:           mijia_board_publish_proposal(request->generation, NULL, true);
3209:         }
3210:       else if (strcmp(request->feedback, "accepted") == 0)
3211:         {
3212:           pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
3213:           if (request->generation == g_mijia.request_generation &&
3214:               g_mijia.board_proposal.valid &&
3215:               strcmp(g_mijia.board_proposal.proposal_id,
3216:                      request->proposal_id) == 0)

3219:                 HOME_PANEL_CLOUD_PROPOSAL_ACCEPTED;
3220:               g_mijia.board_proposal.update_revision =
3221:                 ++g_mijia.next_board_update_revision;

3224:         }
3225:     }

3229:   /* Always release the flag; a stale-generation worker must not wedge the
3230:    * board agent channel until the next login.
3231:    */
3232:   g_mijia.board_agent_busy = false;
3233:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
3234:   syslog(ret == 0 ? LOG_INFO : LOG_WARNING,
3235:          "[HOME][AGENT] board request=%u ret=%d status=%u bytes=%u\n",
3236:          (unsigned int)request->kind, ret, http_status,
3237:          (unsigned int)strlen(response));
3238:   cJSON_free(body);
3239:   cJSON_Delete(root);
3240:   cJSON_Delete(payload);
3241:   free(request->model);
3242:   memset(request->token, 0, sizeof(request->token));
3243:   free(request);
3244:   return NULL;
3245: }

3247: static int mijia_start_board_agent_request(
3248:   struct mijia_board_agent_request_s *request)
3249: {
3250:   pthread_attr_t attr;
3251:   pthread_t thread;
3252:   int ret;
3253: 
3254:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
3255:   if (!g_mijia.initialized ||
3256:       g_mijia.snapshot.state != HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_AUTHENTICATED ||
3257:       g_mijia.token[0] == '\0')
3258:     {
3259:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
3260:       return -EACCES;
3261:     }
3262:   if (g_mijia.board_agent_busy)
3263:     {
3264:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
3265:       return -EBUSY;
3266:     }
3267:   request->generation = g_mijia.request_generation;
3268:   mijia_copy_string(request->token, sizeof(request->token), g_mijia.token);
3269:   g_mijia.board_agent_busy = true;
3270:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
3271: 
3272:   ret = pthread_attr_init(&attr);
3273:   if (ret == 0)
3274:     {
3275:       pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, MIJIA_BOARD_AGENT_THREAD_STACK);
3276:       pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attr, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
3277:       mijia_configure_background_thread(&attr);
3278:       ret = pthread_create(&thread, &attr, mijia_board_agent_worker,
3279:                            request);
3280:       pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
3281:     }
3282:   if (ret != 0)
3283:     {
3284:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
3285:       g_mijia.board_agent_busy = false;
3286:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
3287:     }
3288:   return ret;
3289: }

2232: static int refresh_family_model(
2233:   const struct home_panel_mijia_family_snapshot_s *snapshot,
2234:   const struct home_panel_family_model_s *model)
2235: {
2236:   bool changed;
2237:   bool structure_changed;
2238: 
2239:   if (snapshot == NULL || model == NULL || snapshot->revision == 0 ||
2240:       snapshot->json_size == 0 || model->revision != snapshot->revision)
2241:     {
2242:       return -EAGAIN;
2243:     }
2244: 
2245:   /* The client only hands out a new model when its revision changed, so a
2246:    * full 118 KiB memcmp here would always be true.  Compare the revision
2247:    * field instead and skip the expensive scan.
2248:    */
2249: 
2250:   changed = !g_family_model_valid ||
2251:             model->revision != g_family_model.revision;
2252:   if (changed)
2253:     {
2254:       structure_changed = !g_family_model_valid ||
2255:         family_structure_changed(&g_family_model, model);
2256:       if (g_family_model_valid)
2257:         {
2258:           proactive_ctrl_observe_model_changes(&g_family_model, model);
2259:         }
2260:       memcpy(&g_family_model, model, sizeof(g_family_model));
2261:       g_family_model_valid = true;
2262:       if (structure_changed)
2263:         {
2264:           g_family_ui_revision++;
2265:           if (g_family_ui_revision == 0)
2266:             {
2267:               g_family_ui_revision = 1;
2268:             }
2269:         }
2270:       else
2271:         {
2272:           update_model_widgets();
2273:         }
2274:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
2275:              "[HOME][MODEL] revision=%u devices=%u online=%u rooms=%u "
2276:              "scenes=%u event=%s mqtt=%u update=%s\n",
2277:              (unsigned int)model->revision, model->device_count,
2278:              model->online_count, model->room_count, model->scene_count,
2279:              model->event_source, model->mqtt_connected ? 1 : 0,
2280:              structure_changed ? "rebuild" : "in-place");
2281:       return structure_changed ? 0 : 2;
2282:     }
2283: 
2284:   g_family_model.revision = model->revision;
2285:   syslog(LOG_INFO,
2286:          "[HOME][MODEL] revision=%u display-unchanged\n",
2287:          (unsigned int)model->revision);
2288:   return 1;
2289: }

2295: static void cb_device_toggled(lv_event_t *event)
2296: {
2297:   lv_obj_t *button = lv_event_get_target(event);
2298:   struct home_ui_device_binding_s *binding =
2299:     lv_event_get_user_data(event);
2300:   bool requested;
2301:   int ret;
2302: 
2303:   if (binding == NULL || binding->device == NULL ||
2304:       !binding->device->power_writable || !binding->device->online)
2305:     {
2306:       return;
2307:     }
2308: 
2309:   requested = lv_obj_has_state(button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2310:   ret = home_panel_mijia_request_bool_property(binding->device->did,
2311:                                                 binding->device->name,
2312:                                                 "on",
2313:                                                 binding->device->power_siid,
2314:                                                 binding->device->power_piid,
2315:                                                 requested);
2316: 
2317:   if (ret == 0)
2318:     {
2319:       /* Optimistic update: keep the user's intended state while the cloud
2320:        * confirm is in flight.  Rolling back to the stale model value makes
2321:        * the switch bounce and fights the user's gesture.
2322:        */
2323: 
2324:       lv_obj_add_state(button, LV_STATE_DISABLED);
2325:       lv_label_set_text(binding->state_label,
2326:                         requested ? "正在开启" : "正在关闭");
2327:       lv_obj_set_style_text_color(binding->state_label,
2328:                                   lv_color_hex(COLOR_BLUE), 0);
2329:       set_command_status(ret);
2330:     }
2331:   else
2332:     {
2333:       /* Revert to the authoritative model value only on failure. */
2334: 
2335:       if (binding->device->power)
2336:         {
2337:           lv_obj_add_state(button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2338:         }
2339:       else
2340:         {
2341:           lv_obj_remove_state(button, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
2342:         }
2343: 
2344:       set_command_status(ret);
2345:     }
2346: }

5: #include "home_ui_internal.h"

7: /* Internal helpers */
8: 
9: static int device_card_score(const struct home_panel_device_s *device)
10: {
11:   if (!device->online || !device->power_writable)
12:     {
13:       return -1;
14:     }
15: 
16:   if (strcmp(device->type, "light") == 0)
17:     {
18:       return 100;
19:     }
20:   if (strcmp(device->type, "switch") == 0)
21:     {
22:       return 80;
23:     }
24:   if (strcmp(device->type, "outlet") == 0)
25:     {
26:       return 60;
27:     }
28:   return 20;
29: }
30: 
31: static unsigned int select_device_cards(unsigned int selected[3])
32: {
33:   bool used[HOME_PANEL_MAX_DEVICES] = {false};
34:   unsigned int count = 0;
35: 
36:   while (count < 3)
37:     {
38:       int best_score = -1;
39:       unsigned int best = 0;
40:       unsigned int index;
41: 
42:       for (index = 0; index < g_ui.family_model->device_count; index++)
43:         {
44:           int score;
45: 
46:           if (used[index])
47:             {
48:               continue;
49:             }
50:           score = device_card_score(&g_ui.family_model->devices[index]);
51:           if (score > best_score)
52:             {
53:               best_score = score;
54:               best = index;
55:             }
56:         }
57: 
58:       if (best_score < 0)
59:         {
60:           break;
61:         }
62:       used[best] = true;
63:       selected[count++] = best;
64:     }
65: 
66:   return count;
67: }
68:

103:                                    HOME_PANEL_CARD_IDLE);
104:   lv_obj_set_style_shadow_width(card, 0, 0);

168:     }

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
REPO_ROOT=$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)
WORKSPACE=$(realpath "${1:-$REPO_ROOT/..}")
JOBS=${JOBS:-$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || echo 1)}
export PATH="$REPO_ROOT/scripts/tools:$PATH"

VERSION=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$REPO_ROOT/VERSION")
if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "error: invalid four-part version: $VERSION" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! grep -q "\"version\": \"$VERSION\"" \
  "$REPO_ROOT/board/d13x-hengshan-pi/pack/image_cfg.json"; then
  echo "error: VERSION and image_cfg.json do not match" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! grep -q "version = \"$VERSION\";" \
  "$REPO_ROOT/board/d13x-hengshan-pi/pack/d13x_os.its"; then
  echo "error: VERSION and d13x_os.its do not match" >&2
  exit 1
fi

cd "$WORKSPACE/nuttx"

# Always rebuild every NuttX object and regenerate the configuration.  Keep the
# application output variables out of the distclean environment: apps/Makefile
# recursively removes BINDIR, so exporting the NuttX source root there would
# delete the checkout itself.

echo "Removing previous NuttX build outputs..."
env -u APPSDIR -u APPSBINDIR -u BINDIR make distclean
find "$WORKSPACE/nuttx" "$WORKSPACE/apps" -type f \
  \( -name '*.o' -o -name '*.obj' -o -name '*.d' -o \
     -name '.depend' -o -name '.built' \) -delete

# distclean also removes downloaded application sources.  Integrate only
# after it finishes so LVGL is restored and its NuttX compatibility patches
# cannot be discarded by the cleanup step.

"$SCRIPT_DIR/integrate.sh" "$WORKSPACE"

export APPSDIR="$WORKSPACE/apps"
export APPSBINDIR="$WORKSPACE/apps"
export BINDIR="$WORKSPACE/nuttx"

BOARD_CONFIG=../vendor/artinchip/boards/d13x-hengshan-pi/configs/nsh
./tools/configure.sh "$BOARD_CONFIG"
make -j"$JOBS"

# The application executes from the 8 MiB PSRAM initialized by PBP.  Validate
# both the ELF entry and every loadable segment before constructing the FIT.

PSRAM_BASE=$((0x40000000))
PSRAM_END=$((0x40800000))
ELF="$WORKSPACE/nuttx/nuttx"
ENTRY=$(readelf -h "$ELF" |
  awk '/Entry point address:|入口点地址/ { print $NF }')

if ((ENTRY != PSRAM_BASE)); then
  printf 'error: NuttX entry is %s, expected 0x%08x\n' \
    "${ENTRY:-unknown}" "$PSRAM_BASE" >&2
  exit 1
fi

while read -r vaddr filesz memsz; do
  segment_start=$((vaddr))
  segment_file_end=$((vaddr + filesz))
  segment_mem_end=$((vaddr + memsz))
  if ((segment_start < PSRAM_BASE || segment_file_end > PSRAM_END ||
       segment_mem_end > PSRAM_END)); then
    printf 'error: LOAD segment %s..0x%x (memory 0x%x) is outside PSRAM\n' \
      "$vaddr" "$segment_file_end" "$segment_mem_end" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done < <(readelf -W -l "$ELF" |
  awk '$1 == "LOAD" { print $3, $5, $6 }')

LOAD_BYTES=$(riscv32-unknown-elf-size "$ELF" |
  awk 'NR == 2 { print $1 + $2 }')
echo "NuttX PSRAM load image: $LOAD_BYTES bytes; entry=$ENTRY"

cd "$WORKSPACE/vendor/artinchip/pack"
./pack.sh hengshan-pi d13x

IMAGE="$WORKSPACE/vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/d13x_hengshan-pi_v$VERSION.img"
test -s "$IMAGE"
sha256sum "$WORKSPACE/nuttx/nuttx" "$IMAGE"

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * D13x Hengshan-Pi redundant persistent record storage
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <arch/board/board.h>
8: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
9: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
10: #include <nuttx/mutex.h>
11: 
12: #include <errno.h>
13: #include <stdbool.h>
14: #include <stdint.h>
15: #include <string.h>
16: 
17: /* The packed layout reserves 0x0c0000..0x0fffff for userid.  That partition
18:  * is intentionally absent from image.target, so firmware updates do not
19:  * erase it.  Keep the redundant records in its final two erase sectors.
20:  *
21:  * The original implementation used the final two sectors of data.  Retain
22:  * those addresses as a read-only migration source for boards updated without
23:  * reflashing the data component.
24:  */
25: 
26: #define D13X_PERSIST_SLOT0          0x000fe000u
27: #define D13X_PERSIST_SLOT1          0x000ff000u
28: #define D13X_AGENT_PERSIST_SLOT0    0x000fc000u
29: #define D13X_AGENT_PERSIST_SLOT1    0x000fd000u
30: #define D13X_PERSIST_LEGACY_SLOT0   0x00efe000u
31: #define D13X_PERSIST_LEGACY_SLOT1   0x00eff000u
32: #define D13X_PERSIST_PAGE_SIZE      256u
33: #define D13X_PERSIST_MAX_PAYLOAD    3072u
34: 
35: #define D13X_PERSIST_MAGIC          0x44505231u /* DPR1 */
36: #define D13X_PERSIST_VERSION        1u
37: 
38: #define D13X_QSPI_BASE              0x10400000u
39: #define QSPI_CFG                    (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x004u)
40: #define QSPI_TCFG                   (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x008u)
41: #define QSPI_ICR                    (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x010u)
42: #define QSPI_ISTS                   (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x014u)
43: #define QSPI_FCTL                   (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x018u)
44: #define QSPI_FSTS                   (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x01cu)
45: #define QSPI_CCFG                   (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x024u)
46: #define QSPI_TBC                    (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x030u)
47: #define QSPI_TWC                    (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x034u)
48: #define QSPI_TMC                    (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x038u)
49: #define QSPI_TXD                    (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x200u)
50: #define QSPI_RXD                    (D13X_QSPI_BASE + 0x300u)
51: 
52: #define QSPI_CFG_ENABLE             (1u << 0)
53: #define QSPI_CFG_MASTER             (1u << 1)
54: #define QSPI_CFG_XIP                (1u << 2)
55: #define QSPI_CFG_RXFULL_STOP        (1u << 7)
56: #define QSPI_CFG_RESET              (1u << 31)
57: 
58: #define QSPI_TCFG_CS_POL_LOW        (1u << 2)
59: #define QSPI_TCFG_CS_VALID_CTL      (1u << 3)
60: #define QSPI_TCFG_CS_SOFTWARE       (1u << 6)
61: #define QSPI_TCFG_CS_LEVEL          (1u << 7)
62: #define QSPI_TCFG_DROP_INVALID      (1u << 8)
63: #define QSPI_TCFG_RX_DELAY_ONE      (1u << 11)
64: #define QSPI_TCFG_LSB_FIRST         (1u << 12)
65: #define QSPI_TCFG_RX_DELAY_NONE     (1u << 13)
66: #define QSPI_TCFG_TX_DELAY          (1u << 14)
67: #define QSPI_TCFG_START             (1u << 31)
68: 
69: #define QSPI_FCTL_RX_RESET          (1u << 15)
70: #define QSPI_FCTL_TX_RESET          (1u << 31)
71: #define QSPI_FSTS_RX_COUNT_MASK     0xffu
72: #define QSPI_FSTS_TX_COUNT_SHIFT    16
73: #define QSPI_FSTS_TX_COUNT_MASK     (0xffu << QSPI_FSTS_TX_COUNT_SHIFT)
74: #define QSPI_ISTS_DONE              (1u << 12)
75: #define QSPI_ISTS_FIFO_ERRORS       (0x0fu << 8)
76: #define QSPI_TMC_WIDTH_MASK         ((1u << 28) | (1u << 29))
77: 
78: #define SPINOR_CMD_READ             0x03u
79: #define SPINOR_CMD_READ_STATUS      0x05u
80: #define SPINOR_CMD_WRITE_ENABLE     0x06u
81: #define SPINOR_CMD_PAGE_PROGRAM     0x02u
82: #define SPINOR_CMD_SECTOR_ERASE     0x20u
83: #define SPINOR_STATUS_BUSY          0x01u
84: #define SPINOR_STATUS_WEL           0x02u
85: 
86: struct d13x_persist_header_s
87: {
88:   uint32_t magic;
89:   uint32_t version;
90:   uint32_t sequence;
91:   uint32_t length;
92:   uint32_t crc32;
93:   uint32_t reserved[3];
94: };
95: 
96: static bool g_qspi_ready;
97: static mutex_t g_qspi_lock = NXMUTEX_INITIALIZER;
98: 
99: static inline uint32_t d13x_getreg32(uintptr_t address)
100: {
101:   return *(volatile uint32_t *)address;
102: }
103: 
104: static inline void d13x_putreg32(uint32_t value, uintptr_t address)
105: {
106:   *(volatile uint32_t *)address = value;
107: }
108: 
109: static inline uint8_t d13x_getreg8(uintptr_t address)
110: {
111:   return *(volatile uint8_t *)address;
112: }
113: 
114: static inline void d13x_putreg8(uint8_t value, uintptr_t address)
115: {
116:   *(volatile uint8_t *)address = value;
117: }
118: 
119: #define getreg32 d13x_getreg32
120: #define putreg32 d13x_putreg32
121: #define getreg8  d13x_getreg8
122: #define putreg8  d13x_putreg8
123: 
124: static uint32_t d13x_crc32(const uint8_t *data, size_t length)
125: {
126:   uint32_t crc = 0xffffffffu;
127:   size_t i;
128:   unsigned int bit;
129: 
130:   for (i = 0; i < length; i++)
131:     {
132:       crc ^= data[i];
133:       for (bit = 0; bit < 8; bit++)
134:         {
135:           crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xedb88320u &
136:                               (uint32_t)-(int32_t)(crc & 1u));
137:         }
138:     }
139: 
140:   return ~crc;
141: }
142: 
143: static void d13x_qspi_initialize(void)
144: {
145:   uint32_t value;
146: 
147:   if (g_qspi_ready)
148:     {
149:       return;
150:     }
151: 
152:   /* tinySPL has already enabled the clock and configured the pins.  Reset
153:    * only the controller state and retain its known-good clock divider.
154:    */
155: 
156:   putreg32(QSPI_CFG_ENABLE | QSPI_CFG_MASTER | QSPI_CFG_RXFULL_STOP |
157:            QSPI_CFG_RESET, QSPI_CFG);
158:   value = getreg32(QSPI_CFG);
159:   value &= ~QSPI_CFG_XIP;
160:   value |= QSPI_CFG_ENABLE | QSPI_CFG_MASTER | QSPI_CFG_RXFULL_STOP;
161:   putreg32(value, QSPI_CFG);
162: 
163:   /* QSPI0 input is 100 MHz after tinySPL.  Divider-1 value 1 gives a
164:    * conservative 50 MHz for erase/program and is accepted by all supported
165:    * 3-byte-address SPI-NOR parts.
166:    */
167: 
168:   putreg32(1u << 8, QSPI_CCFG);
169: 
170:   value = getreg32(QSPI_TCFG);
171:   value &= ~((3u << 0) | QSPI_TCFG_CS_POL_LOW |
172:              QSPI_TCFG_CS_VALID_CTL | (3u << 4) |
173:              QSPI_TCFG_CS_SOFTWARE | QSPI_TCFG_CS_LEVEL |
174:              QSPI_TCFG_DROP_INVALID | QSPI_TCFG_RX_DELAY_ONE |
175:              QSPI_TCFG_LSB_FIRST | QSPI_TCFG_RX_DELAY_NONE |
176:              QSPI_TCFG_TX_DELAY | QSPI_TCFG_START);
177:   value |= QSPI_TCFG_CS_POL_LOW | QSPI_TCFG_CS_SOFTWARE |
178:            QSPI_TCFG_CS_LEVEL | QSPI_TCFG_DROP_INVALID |
179:            QSPI_TCFG_TX_DELAY;
180:   putreg32(value, QSPI_TCFG);
181: 
182:   value = getreg32(QSPI_TMC);
183:   value &= ~QSPI_TMC_WIDTH_MASK;
184:   putreg32(value, QSPI_TMC);
185:   putreg32(0, QSPI_ICR);
186:   putreg32(0xffffffffu, QSPI_ISTS);
187:   g_qspi_ready = true;
188: }
189: 
190: static void d13x_qspi_select(bool selected)
191: {
192:   uint32_t value = getreg32(QSPI_TCFG);
193: 
194:   if (selected)
195:     {
196:       value &= ~QSPI_TCFG_CS_LEVEL;
197:     }
198:   else
199:     {
200:       value |= QSPI_TCFG_CS_LEVEL;
201:     }
202: 
203:   putreg32(value, QSPI_TCFG);
204: }
205: 
206: static int d13x_qspi_wait_done(void)
207: {
208:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(200);
209:   uint32_t status;
210: 
211:   for (;;)
212:     {
213:       status = getreg32(QSPI_ISTS);
214:       if ((status & QSPI_ISTS_FIFO_ERRORS) != 0)
215:         {
216:           putreg32(status, QSPI_ISTS);
217:           return -EIO;
218:         }
219: 
220:       if ((status & QSPI_ISTS_DONE) != 0)
221:         {
222:           putreg32(status, QSPI_ISTS);
223:           return 0;
224:         }
225: 
226:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
227:         {
228:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
229:         }
230:     }
231: }
232: 
233: static int d13x_qspi_transfer(const uint8_t *tx, uint8_t *rx,
234:                               size_t length)
235: {
236:   clock_t deadline;
237:   size_t remaining = length;
238:   uint32_t count;
239:   uint32_t value;
240: 
241:   if (length == 0 || (tx == NULL && rx == NULL) || length > 0xffffffu)
242:     {
243:       return -EINVAL;
244:     }
245: 
246:   putreg32(QSPI_FCTL_RX_RESET | QSPI_FCTL_TX_RESET | (32u << 16) | 32u,
247:            QSPI_FCTL);
248:   putreg32(0xffffffffu, QSPI_ISTS);
249:   putreg32((uint32_t)length, QSPI_TBC);
250:   putreg32(tx != NULL ? (uint32_t)length : 0u, QSPI_TWC);
251:   value = getreg32(QSPI_TMC) & QSPI_TMC_WIDTH_MASK;
252:   if (tx != NULL)
253:     {
254:       value |= (uint32_t)length;
255:     }
256:   putreg32(value, QSPI_TMC);
257:   putreg32(getreg32(QSPI_TCFG) | QSPI_TCFG_START, QSPI_TCFG);
258: 
259:   deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(200);
260:   while (remaining > 0)
261:     {
262:       if (tx != NULL)
263:         {
264:           count = (getreg32(QSPI_FSTS) & QSPI_FSTS_TX_COUNT_MASK) >>
265:                   QSPI_FSTS_TX_COUNT_SHIFT;
266:           count = 64u - count;
267:           if (count > remaining)
268:             {
269:               count = remaining;
270:             }
271:           while (count-- > 0)
272:             {
273:               putreg8(*tx++, QSPI_TXD);
274:               remaining--;
275:             }
276:         }
277:       else
278:         {
279:           count = getreg32(QSPI_FSTS) & QSPI_FSTS_RX_COUNT_MASK;
280:           if (count > remaining)
281:             {
282:               count = remaining;
283:             }
284:           while (count-- > 0)
285:             {
286:               *rx++ = getreg8(QSPI_RXD);
287:               remaining--;
288:             }
289:         }
290: 
291:       if (remaining > 0 &&
292:           (int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
293:         {
294:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
295:         }
296:     }
297: 
298:   return d13x_qspi_wait_done();
299: }
300: 
301: static int d13x_spinor_command(const uint8_t *command, size_t command_length,
302:                                uint8_t *data, size_t data_length)
303: {
304:   int ret;
305: 
306:   d13x_qspi_initialize();
307:   d13x_qspi_select(true);
308:   ret = d13x_qspi_transfer(command, NULL, command_length);
309:   if (ret == 0 && data != NULL && data_length > 0)
310:     {
311:       ret = d13x_qspi_transfer(NULL, data, data_length);
312:     }
313:   d13x_qspi_select(false);
314:   return ret;
315: }
316: 
317: static int d13x_spinor_write_command(const uint8_t *command,
318:                                      size_t command_length,
319:                                      const uint8_t *data,
320:                                      size_t data_length)
321: {
322:   int ret;
323: 
324:   d13x_qspi_initialize();
325:   d13x_qspi_select(true);
326:   ret = d13x_qspi_transfer(command, NULL, command_length);
327:   if (ret == 0 && data != NULL && data_length > 0)
328:     {
329:       ret = d13x_qspi_transfer(data, NULL, data_length);
330:     }
331:   d13x_qspi_select(false);
332:   return ret;
333: }
334: 
335: static int d13x_spinor_status(uint8_t *status)
336: {
337:   uint8_t command = SPINOR_CMD_READ_STATUS;
338: 
339:   return d13x_spinor_command(&command, 1, status, 1);
340: }
341: 
342: static int d13x_spinor_wait_ready(void)
343: {
344:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + SEC2TICK(3);
345:   uint8_t status;
346:   int ret;
347: 
348:   do
349:     {
350:       ret = d13x_spinor_status(&status);
351:       if (ret < 0 || (status & SPINOR_STATUS_BUSY) == 0)
352:         {
353:           return ret;
354:         }
355: 
356:       up_udelay(100);
357:     }
358:   while ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) < 0);
359: 
360:   return -ETIMEDOUT;
361: }
362: 
363: static int d13x_spinor_write_enable(void)
364: {
365:   uint8_t command = SPINOR_CMD_WRITE_ENABLE;
366:   uint8_t status;
367:   int ret;
368: 
369:   ret = d13x_spinor_write_command(&command, 1, NULL, 0);
370:   if (ret == 0)
371:     {
372:       ret = d13x_spinor_status(&status);
373:       if (ret == 0 && (status & SPINOR_STATUS_WEL) == 0)
374:         {
375:           ret = -EACCES;
376:         }
377:     }
378: 
379:   return ret;
380: }
381: 
382: static int d13x_spinor_read(uint32_t address, void *buffer, size_t length)
383: {
384:   uint8_t command[4] =
385:   {
386:     SPINOR_CMD_READ,
387:     (uint8_t)(address >> 16),
388:     (uint8_t)(address >> 8),
389:     (uint8_t)address
390:   };
391: 
392:   return d13x_spinor_command(command, sizeof(command), buffer, length);
393: }
394: 
395: int board_flash_read(uint32_t address, void *buffer, size_t length)
396: {
397:   int ret;
398: 
399:   if (buffer == NULL || length == 0 || address >= 0x01000000u ||
400:       length > 0x01000000u - address)
401:     {
402:       return -EINVAL;
403:     }
404: 
405:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_qspi_lock);
406:   if (ret < 0)
407:     {
408:       return ret;
409:     }
410: 
411:   ret = d13x_spinor_read(address, buffer, length);
412:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_qspi_lock);
413:   return ret;
414: }
415: 
416: static int d13x_spinor_erase(uint32_t address)
417: {
418:   uint8_t command[4] =
419:   {
420:     SPINOR_CMD_SECTOR_ERASE,
421:     (uint8_t)(address >> 16),
422:     (uint8_t)(address >> 8),
423:     (uint8_t)address
424:   };
425:   int ret;
426: 
427:   ret = d13x_spinor_write_enable();
428:   if (ret == 0)
429:     {
430:       ret = d13x_spinor_write_command(command, sizeof(command), NULL, 0);
431:     }
432: 
433:   return ret == 0 ? d13x_spinor_wait_ready() : ret;
434: }
435: 
436: static int d13x_spinor_program(uint32_t address, const void *buffer,
437:                                size_t length)
438: {
439:   const uint8_t *source = buffer;
440:   size_t chunk;
441:   uint8_t command[4];
442:   int ret;
443: 
444:   while (length > 0)
445:     {
446:       chunk = D13X_PERSIST_PAGE_SIZE -
447:               (address & (D13X_PERSIST_PAGE_SIZE - 1));
448:       if (chunk > length)
449:         {
450:           chunk = length;
451:         }
452: 
453:       command[0] = SPINOR_CMD_PAGE_PROGRAM;
454:       command[1] = (uint8_t)(address >> 16);
455:       command[2] = (uint8_t)(address >> 8);
456:       command[3] = (uint8_t)address;
457:       ret = d13x_spinor_write_enable();
458:       if (ret == 0)
459:         {
460:           ret = d13x_spinor_write_command(command, sizeof(command),
461:                                            source, chunk);
462:         }
463:       if (ret == 0)
464:         {
465:           ret = d13x_spinor_wait_ready();
466:         }
467:       if (ret < 0)
468:         {
469:           return ret;
470:         }
471: 
472:       address += chunk;
473:       source += chunk;
474:       length -= chunk;
475:     }
476: 
477:   return 0;
478: }
479: 
480: static bool d13x_sequence_newer(uint32_t first, uint32_t second)
481: {
482:   return (int32_t)(first - second) > 0;
483: }
484: 
485: static int d13x_read_slot(uint32_t address,
486:                           struct d13x_persist_header_s *header,
487:                           uint8_t *payload)
488: {
489:   int ret;
490: 
491:   ret = d13x_spinor_read(address, header, sizeof(*header));
492:   if (ret < 0)
493:     {
494:       return ret;
495:     }
496: 
497:   if (header->magic != D13X_PERSIST_MAGIC ||
498:       header->version != D13X_PERSIST_VERSION ||
499:       header->length == 0 || header->length > D13X_PERSIST_MAX_PAYLOAD)
500:     {
501:       return -ENOENT;
502:     }
503: 
504:   ret = d13x_spinor_read(address + sizeof(*header), payload,
505:                          header->length);
506:   if (ret < 0)
507:     {
508:       return ret;
509:     }
510: 
511:   return d13x_crc32(payload, header->length) == header->crc32 ?
512:          0 : -EBADMSG;
513: }
514: 
515: static int d13x_read_pair(uint32_t slot0, uint32_t slot1, void *buffer,
516:                           size_t capacity, size_t *length)
517: {
518:   struct d13x_persist_header_s headers[2];
519:   uint8_t payloads[2][D13X_PERSIST_MAX_PAYLOAD];
520:   int results[2];
521:   unsigned int selected;
522: 
523:   results[0] = d13x_read_slot(slot0, &headers[0], payloads[0]);
524:   results[1] = d13x_read_slot(slot1, &headers[1], payloads[1]);
525:   if (results[0] < 0 && results[1] < 0)
526:     {
527:       memset(payloads, 0, sizeof(payloads));
528:       return results[0] != -ENOENT ? results[0] : results[1];
529:     }
530: 
531:   selected = results[0] == 0 &&
532:              (results[1] < 0 ||
533:               d13x_sequence_newer(headers[0].sequence,
534:                                    headers[1].sequence)) ? 0 : 1;
535:   if (capacity < headers[selected].length)
536:     {
537:       memset(payloads, 0, sizeof(payloads));
538:       return -ENOSPC;
539:     }
540: 
541:   memcpy(buffer, payloads[selected], headers[selected].length);
542:   *length = headers[selected].length;
543:   memset(payloads, 0, sizeof(payloads));
544:   return 0;
545: }
546: 
547: static int d13x_write_pair(uint32_t slot0, uint32_t slot1,
548:                            const void *buffer, size_t length)
549: {
550:   struct d13x_persist_header_s headers[2];
551:   uint8_t payload[D13X_PERSIST_MAX_PAYLOAD];
552:   uint8_t verify[D13X_PERSIST_MAX_PAYLOAD];
553:   uint32_t address;
554:   uint32_t sequence;
555:   int results[2];
556:   int ret;
557: 
558:   if (buffer == NULL || length == 0 || length > sizeof(payload))
559:     {
560:       return -EINVAL;
561:     }
562: 
563:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_qspi_lock);
564:   if (ret < 0)
565:     {
566:       return ret;
567:     }
568: 
569:   results[0] = d13x_read_slot(slot0, &headers[0], payload);
570:   results[1] = d13x_read_slot(slot1, &headers[1], payload);
571:   if (results[0] == 0 &&
572:       (results[1] < 0 || d13x_sequence_newer(headers[0].sequence,
573:                                              headers[1].sequence)))
574:     {
575:       address = slot1;
576:       sequence = headers[0].sequence + 1;
577:     }
578:   else if (results[1] == 0)
579:     {
580:       address = slot0;
581:       sequence = headers[1].sequence + 1;
582:     }
583:   else
584:     {
585:       address = slot0;
586:       sequence = 1;
587:     }
588: 
589:   memset(&headers[0], 0xff, sizeof(headers[0]));
590:   headers[0].magic = D13X_PERSIST_MAGIC;
591:   headers[0].version = D13X_PERSIST_VERSION;
592:   headers[0].sequence = sequence;
593:   headers[0].length = length;
594:   headers[0].crc32 = d13x_crc32(buffer, length);
595: 
596:   ret = d13x_spinor_erase(address);
597:   if (ret == 0)
598:     {
599:       ret = d13x_spinor_program(address + sizeof(headers[0]), buffer,
600:                                 length);
601:     }
602:   if (ret == 0)
603:     {
604:       /* Program the validity header last.  A power loss cannot make an
605:        * incomplete payload supersede the previous valid slot.
606:        */
607:       ret = d13x_spinor_program(address, &headers[0], sizeof(headers[0]));
608:     }
609:   if (ret == 0)
610:     {
611:       ret = d13x_read_slot(address, &headers[1], verify);
612:     }
613:   if (ret == 0 &&
614:       (headers[1].sequence != sequence || headers[1].length != length ||
615:        memcmp(buffer, verify, length) != 0))
616:     {
617:       ret = -EIO;
618:     }
619: 
620:   memset(payload, 0, sizeof(payload));
621:   memset(verify, 0, sizeof(verify));
622:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_qspi_lock);
623:   return ret;
624: }
625: 
626: int board_persist_read(void *buffer, size_t capacity, size_t *length)
627: {
628:   bool migrate = false;
629:   int ret;
630: 
631:   if (buffer == NULL || length == NULL)
632:     {
633:       return -EINVAL;
634:     }
635: 
636:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_qspi_lock);
637:   if (ret < 0)
638:     {
639:       return ret;
640:     }
641: 
642:   ret = d13x_read_pair(D13X_PERSIST_SLOT0, D13X_PERSIST_SLOT1, buffer,
643:                        capacity, length);
644:   if (ret < 0)
645:     {
646:       ret = d13x_read_pair(D13X_PERSIST_LEGACY_SLOT0,
647:                            D13X_PERSIST_LEGACY_SLOT1,
648:                            buffer, capacity, length);
649:       if (ret == 0)
650:         {
651:           migrate = true;
652:         }
653:     }
654: 
655:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_qspi_lock);
656: 
657:   /* Best-effort one-time migration into userid.  Do this after releasing the
658:    * QSPI lock because board_persist_write() takes the same lock.
659:    */
660: 
661:   if (migrate)
662:     {
663:       board_persist_write(buffer, *length);
664:     }
665: 
666:   return ret;
667: }
668: 
669: int board_persist_write(const void *buffer, size_t length)
670: {
671:   return d13x_write_pair(D13X_PERSIST_SLOT0, D13X_PERSIST_SLOT1,
672:                          buffer, length);
673: }
674: 
675: int board_agent_persist_read(void *buffer, size_t capacity, size_t *length)
676: {
677:   int ret;
678: 
679:   if (buffer == NULL || length == NULL)
680:     {
681:       return -EINVAL;
682:     }
683: 
684:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_qspi_lock);
685:   if (ret < 0)
686:     {
687:       return ret;
688:     }
689:   ret = d13x_read_pair(D13X_AGENT_PERSIST_SLOT0,
690:                        D13X_AGENT_PERSIST_SLOT1,
691:                        buffer, capacity, length);
692:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_qspi_lock);
693:   return ret;
694: }
695: 
696: int board_agent_persist_write(const void *buffer, size_t length)
697: {
698:   return d13x_write_pair(D13X_AGENT_PERSIST_SLOT0,
699:                          D13X_AGENT_PERSIST_SLOT1,
700:                          buffer, length);

1: # D13x 家庭中控屏
2: 
3: 这是运行在 D13x 衡山派上的 1024x600 横屏 LVGL 原生应用。应用源码通过比赛
4: manifest 映射到 `packages/demos/contest2026_011_home_panel`；本仓库的
5: `scripts/integrate.sh` 同时提供不使用 `repo` 工作区时的本地构建映射。
6: 
7: 当前应用编译为 NSH builtin：
8: 
9: ```text
10: nsh> home_panel
11: ```
12: 
13: 界面直接使用 `/dev/fb0` 的 RGB565 双缓冲和 `/dev/input0` 的 GT911 触摸事件。
14: 账号授权通过有线网络连接独立的 `mijia-api` 服务。点击“登录米家”后，开发板
15: 请求一次性登录会话、显示米家 App 扫码二维码，并在确认后领取短期 Bearer ***REDACTED***，
16: 随后同步家庭、房间、设备属性和场景。小米账号 Cookie 等认证数据只保存在服务端
17: 加密保险箱中；开发板仅将服务端 Bearer ***REDACTED*** 和保险箱解锁口令写入 SPI NOR 的
18: 双槽持久记录，重启后自动解锁并恢复同步。记录采用递增序号和 CRC 校验，写入时
19: 最后提交有效头，避免掉电产生半条有效凭据。
20: 
21: 服务地址由 `CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL` 配置，当前实机测试默认值为
22: `http://192.168.1.24:8123`。服务端应与开发板处于同一有线局域网；二维码登录和
23: 设备同步均在独立工作线程中执行，不阻塞 LVGL 刷新和触摸输入。
24: 
25: 设备控制按 MIoT-Spec V2 的 `did/siid/piid` 构造 `set_properties`。服务端通过
26: 小米云 HTTP 接口下发，设备侧仍由小米云的 OT 通道完成路由；RPC 接受后再定向
27: 读取属性确认真实值。当前增量接口输出 `properties_changed` 兼容事件，但事件源
28: 是云端回读，并未宣称已经接入官方 OAuth MQTT。后续接入官方 MQTT 时，板端事件
29: 模型无需变化。
30: 
31: 面板首次登录或恢复会话时通过 `/api/sync` 获取带 `sync_revision` 的完整快照；
32: 之后只长轮询 `/api/sync/changes?after=<revision>`。服务端缓存上一份已交付状态，
33: 按 `did + siid + piid` 比较属性，并在 64 个连续版本内合并重复变化，只发送最终
34: 的 `properties_changed` 和 `device_online_changed`。板端直接将补丁应用到紧凑
35: 内存模型，不再因单个属性变化下载和解析完整家庭 JSON。设备、房间、场景或能力
36: 结构变化、版本断档及历史溢出时，服务端返回 `resync_required`，板端才回退一次
37: 全量同步。该扩展只修改面板 HTTP 同步层，不伪造小米官方 MQTT 连接，也不改变
38: 设备控制经小米云 OT 通道路由的事实。
39: 
40: 应用后台每秒读取 `eth0` 的 carrier 状态，并每 60 秒依次用 ICMP 检测
41: `mi.com` 与 `xiaomi.cn`。界面区分“有线网络未连接”“无互联网连接”和

# D13x 家庭中控屏

这是运行在 D13x 衡山派上的 1024x600 横屏 LVGL 原生应用。应用源码通过比赛
manifest 映射到 `packages/demos/contest2026_011_home_panel`；本仓库的
`scripts/integrate.sh` 同时提供不使用 `repo` 工作区时的本地构建映射。

当前应用编译为 NSH builtin：

```text
nsh> home_panel
```

界面直接使用 `/dev/fb0` 的 RGB565 双缓冲和 `/dev/input0` 的 GT911 触摸事件。
账号授权通过有线网络连接独立的 `mijia-api` 服务。点击“登录米家”后，开发板
请求一次性登录会话、显示米家 App 扫码二维码，并在确认后领取短期 Bearer ***REDACTED***，
随后同步家庭、房间、设备属性和场景。小米账号 Cookie 等认证数据只保存在服务端
加密保险箱中；开发板仅将服务端 Bearer ***REDACTED*** 和保险箱解锁口令写入 SPI NOR 的
双槽持久记录，重启后自动解锁并恢复同步。记录采用递增序号和 CRC 校验，写入时
最后提交有效头，避免掉电产生半条有效凭据。

服务地址由 `CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL` 配置，当前实机测试默认值为
`http://192.168.1.24:8123`。服务端应与开发板处于同一有线局域网；二维码登录和
设备同步均在独立工作线程中执行，不阻塞 LVGL 刷新和触摸输入。

设备控制按 MIoT-Spec V2 的 `did/siid/piid` 构造 `set_properties`。服务端通过
小米云 HTTP 接口下发，设备侧仍由小米云的 OT 通道完成路由；RPC 接受后再定向
读取属性确认真实值。当前增量接口输出 `properties_changed` 兼容事件，但事件源
是云端回读，并未宣称已经接入官方 OAuth MQTT。后续接入官方 MQTT 时，板端事件
模型无需变化。

面板首次登录或恢复会话时通过 `/api/sync` 获取带 `sync_revision` 的完整快照；
之后只长轮询 `/api/sync/changes?after=<revision>`。服务端缓存上一份已交付状态，
按 `did + siid + piid` 比较属性，并在 64 个连续版本内合并重复变化，只发送最终
的 `properties_changed` 和 `device_online_changed`。板端直接将补丁应用到紧凑
内存模型，不再因单个属性变化下载和解析完整家庭 JSON。设备、房间、场景或能力
结构变化、版本断档及历史溢出时，服务端返回 `resync_required`，板端才回退一次
全量同步。该扩展只修改面板 HTTP 同步层，不伪造小米官方 MQTT 连接，也不改变
设备控制经小米云 OT 通道路由的事实。

应用后台每秒读取 `eth0` 的 carrier 状态，并每 60 秒依次用 ICMP 检测
`mi.com` 与 `xiaomi.cn`。界面区分“有线网络未连接”“无互联网连接”和
“已连接互联网”三种状态；设置页的“重新检测网络”按钮可立即触发一次检测。
DNS 服务器由 DHCP 配置，网络检测运行在独立线程，不阻塞 LVGL 与触摸事件。

SPI NOR 使用完整 16 MiB 的显式分区布局：系统 3 MiB、完整 MiSans 字符集
BinFont 8 MiB、数据 4 MiB，并预留独立的 256 KiB `userid` 分区。字体不进入
NuttX 镜像，而是在构建时从完整 TTF 预编译为 1 bpp LVGL BinFont，写入
SPI NOR 并由板端按需读取字形，避免运行时 TTF 解析与浮点栅格化。登录凭据双槽位于 `userid`
末尾 8 KiB；该分区不写入升级镜像，因此更新系统、资源或数据分区不会清除登录。

## 开源项目与第三方组件

### 固件运行时依赖

- [OpenVela](https://github.com/open-vela/openvela)：系统工作区、板级集成与应用框架。
- [Apache NuttX](https://github.com/apache/nuttx)：RTOS 内核、NSH、framebuffer、
  I2C 和 touchscreen 子系统，Apache-2.0 许可证。
- [LVGL](https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl)：家庭中控屏图形与事件框架，MIT 许可证；
  当前固件使用 LVGL 9.2.1。
- [cJSON](https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON)：解析 `mijia-api` 登录状态与设备
  响应，MIT 许可证；由 OpenVela `NETUTILS_CJSON` 组件集成。
- [ArtInChip Luban-Lite](https://gitee.com/artinchip/luban-lite)：D13x 启动、显示、
  时钟与外设实现的移植参考；其代码不作为本应用的独立运行时库加载。

### 服务端接口参考

- [mijia-api](https://github.com/Do1e/mijia-api)：提供米家 App 扫码登录、家庭、
  设备、属性和场景接口，GPL-3.0 许可证。该项目独立运行在服务器侧，不链接进
  D13x 固件；开发板只通过 HTTP API 与其通信。
- [Xiaomi Home Integration](https://github.com/XiaoMi/ha_xiaomi_home)：小米官方
  Home Assistant 集成，用于核对“HTTP 控制、MQTT 属性/事件订阅”的官方云端
  架构和 MIoT-Spec 消息语义；仅作协议与架构参考，不复制进固件。

### 字体与生成工具

- [MiSans](https://hyperos.mi.com/font/zh/)：界面中文字体。构建资产保留完整
  `MiSans-Regular.ttf`，镜像使用覆盖字体全部字符的 1 bpp LVGL 压缩二进制
  字体，支持服务端返回的动态中文设备名和房间名，并依据
  [MiSans 字体知识产权许可协议](https://hyperos.mi.com/font-download/MiSans%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%E7%9F%A5%E8%AF%86%E4%BA%A7%E6%9D%83%E8%AE%B8%E5%8F%AF%E5%8D%8F%E8%AE%AE.pdf)
  使用和注明；MiSans 本身不是本项目的开源代码。
- [lv_font_conv](https://github.com/lvgl/lv_font_conv)：将完整 MiSans 预编译为
  LVGL 二进制字体，避免开发板运行时解析 TTF 和执行浮点光栅化，MIT 许可证。

#!/bin/sh

set -eu

if [ "$#" -lt 1 ] || [ "$#" -gt 2 ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <firmware.img> [artifact-root]" >&2
  exit 2
fi

image=$1
artifact_root=${2:-validation-artifacts}

if [ ! -f "$image" ]; then
  echo "Firmware image not found: $image" >&2
  exit 1
fi

repo=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
version=$(cat "$repo/VERSION")
run_id="${version}-$(date '+%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')"
case "$artifact_root" in
  /*) output="$artifact_root/$version/$run_id" ;;
  *)  output="$repo/$artifact_root/$version/$run_id" ;;
esac

mkdir -p "$output"
cp "$repo/tests/RESULT_TEMPLATE.md" "$output/result.md"
sha256sum "$image" > "$output/image.sha256"

{
  printf 'run_id=%s\n' "$run_id"
  printf 'version=%s\n' "$version"
  printf 'image=%s\n' "$(realpath "$image")"
  printf 'git_commit=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
  printf 'git_branch=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current)"
  printf 'created_at=%s\n' "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)"
  printf '\n[git status --short]\n'
  git -C "$repo" status --short
} > "$output/source.txt"

printf 'Created validation run: %s\n' "$output"

I have now thoroughly explored the entire project. Here is my comprehensive report of all relevant code sections.

---

## Complete Findings Report

### Project Structure Overview

The project at `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio` is a NuttX-based RTOS application for a D13x Hengshan-Pi (RISC-V) development board running a 1024x600 LVGL home control panel. The main application code lives in `app/home_panel/` with UI pages in `app/home_panel/ui/`.

---

### 1. Login Flow on the Development Board (D13x)

The login flow is implemented across two files: the UI layer in `home_panel_main.c` and the HTTP client layer in `home_panel_mijia_client.c`.

#### 1a. Login UI Entry Point (login button on top bar)

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_main.c`

- **Lines 2579-2597:** The top bar login button is created in `create_home_screen()`. It is labeled "登录米家" and triggers `show_login()` on click.

```c
login = lv_button_create(topbar);          // line 2579
g_login_top_button = login;                // line 2580
lv_obj_add_event_cb(login, show_login, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, NULL);  // line 2593
g_login_top_label = lv_label_create(login);  // line 2594
lv_label_set_text(g_login_top_label, "登录米家");  // line 2595
```

- **Lines 133-138:** Login widget macro aliases to shared UI state:
```c
#define g_login_top_button      g_ui.login_top_button    // line 133
#define g_login_top_label       g_ui.login_top_label     // line 134
#define g_login_shade           g_ui.login_shade         // line 135
#define g_login_qr              g_ui.login_qr            // line 136
#define g_login_message         g_ui.login_message       // line 137
#define g_login_action_label    g_ui.login_action_label  // line 138
```

#### 1b. Login Dialog Display (`show_login`)

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_main.c`

- **Lines 1212-1320:** `show_login()` creates a modal overlay on `lv_layer_top()` with:
  - Title: "米家账号登录" (line 1251)
  - QR code image placeholder (lines 1255-1261)
  - Status message "正在准备米家登录" (lines 1263-1268)
  - Instruction text: "请使用米家 App 扫码。账号认证数据只保存在本地服务端的加密保险箱中。" (lines 1270-1275)
  - Close button (X) (lines 1277-1290)
  - Action button labeled "重新生成" (lines 1292-1304)
  - If already authenticated, applies snapshot directly (lines 1306-1310)
  - If online but not authenticated, calls `home_panel_mijia_request_login()` (lines 1311-1313)
  - If network offline, shows "请先连接可访问互联网的有线网络" (lines 1315-1319)

#### 1c. Login Action Button Handler

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_main.c`

- **Lines 1188-1210:** `login_action()` handles the "重新生成" button:
  - If already authenticated, closes the dialog
  - If network offline, shows "请先连接可访问互联网的有线网络"
  - Calls `home_panel_mijia_request_login()` to restart the login flow
  - If service not ready: "米家登录服务尚未就绪"

#### 1d. QR Code Rendering

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_main.c`

- **Lines 1075-1186:** `login_update_qr()` downloads and displays the QR code:
  - Copies QR data from the client snapshot using `home_panel_mijia_copy_qr()`
  - Validates the RGB565 240x240 image via LVGL decoder
  - Handles dark pixel counting for validation
  - Various error states: "登录二维码加载失败" (line 1419)

#### 1e. Login Request (triggers background worker)

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_mijia_client.c`

- **Lines 3589-3629:** `home_panel_mijia_request_login()`:
  - Increments `request_generation` (invalidates any old login flow)
  - Sets state to `HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_STARTING` with message "正在连接米家服务"
  - Clears QR, token, command, agent, board_agent state
  - Signals the worker thread via `pthread_cond_signal`

#### 1f. Login Backend Flow (QR-code based login)

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_mijia_client.c`

- **Lines 1566-1701:** `mijia_process_login()` -- the complete login flow:
  1. **POST `/api/login/start`** (line 674): Gets `session_id`, `claim_secret`, `login_url`
  2. **GET `/api/login/qr.rgb565?session_id=...`** (line 585): Downloads QR code image
  3. **Polls GET `/api/login/status?session_id=...`** (lines 729-731): Every 2 seconds for up to 90 polls (3 minutes)
  4. On "success": **POST `/api/login/claim`** (line 787): Claims the Bearer ***REDACTED***
  5. **POST `/api/session/set_vault_password`** (line 845): Sets encrypted vault password
  6. **GET `/api/sync`** (line 1034): Fetches full family model
  7. **Saves credentials** to SPI NOR persistent storage (line 1666)
  8. Publishes `HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_AUTHENTICATED` with "米家账号登录成功" (lines 1691-1693)

- **Lines 664-716:** `mijia_start_login()`: POST to `/api/login/start` -- starts the session
- **Lines 561-662:** `mijia_download_login_qr()`: GET to download QR image in RGB565 wire format
- **Lines 718-759:** `mijia_get_login_status()`: GET to poll login status
- **Lines 761-816:** `mijia_claim_login()`: POST to `/api/login/claim` -- claims Bearer ***REDACTED***
- **Lines 818-885:** `mijia_set_vault_password()`: POST to `/api/session/set_vault_password`

#### 1g. Error States in Login Flow

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_mijia_client.c`

- Line 1588-1590: "无法连接米家服务" (Cannot connect to Mijia service)
- Line 1597-1599: "登录二维码下载失败" (QR code download failed)
- Line 1617-1619: "登录状态查询失败" (Login status query failed)
- Line 1630-1634: "米家登录失败" / expired/timeout messages
- Line 1642-1644: "登录凭据领取失败" (Credential claim failed)
- Line 1650-1652: "账号保险箱初始化失败" (Vault initialization failed)
- Line 1661-1663: "已登录，但设备同步失败" (Logged in, but device sync failed)
- Line 1672-1677: "已登录，但登录状态保存失败" (Logged in, but credential save failed)
- Line 1698-1700: "二维码已过期，请重新生成" (QR expired, regenerate)

#### 1h. Auto-login (Restore Persisted Session)

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_mijia_client.c`

- **Lines 1703-1769:** `mijia_restore_session()`:
  1. Loads token + vault password from SPI NOR via `board_persist_read()`
  2. POST to `/api/session/unlock` with password
  3. GET `/api/sync` to fetch family model
  4. Publishes "米家账号已自动登录" on success

- **Lines 3383-3535:** `mijia_worker()` -- the main background thread:
  - On startup, sets `restore_pending = true` and attempts `mijia_restore_session()` (lines 3414-3448)
  - Retries restore every 3 seconds if network is unavailable
  - On permanent failure (ENOENT/EBADMSG/EACCES), publishes "登录已失效，请重新登录" or "点击登录米家" (lines 3431-3434)
  - After successful auth, enters the long-poll delta sync loop (lines 3466-3532)

- **Lines 3540-3587:** `home_panel_mijia_initialize()`:
  - Sets initial state to `HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_STARTING` with message "正在检查米家登录"
  - Creates the `mijia_worker` thread

- **Lines 2848-2856 (in main.c):** Auto-start login on first boot:
  ```c
  if (!g_login_autostart_attempted &&
      g_network_state == NETWORK_ONLINE &&
      mijia_snapshot.state == HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_IDLE)
    {
      g_login_autostart_attempted = true;
      show_login(NULL);
    }
  ```

---

### 2. Device Sync Flow After Login

#### 2a. Full Family Sync (`/api/sync`)

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_mijia_client.c`

- **Lines 990-1152:** `mijia_fetch_family()`:
  - GET to `CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL + "/api/sync"` (line 1034)
  - Uses `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (line 1037)
  - Parses JSON response with `summary`, `homes`, `devices`, `scenes` arrays
  - Validates `sync_revision`, `generated_at`, `detail_error_count`
  - Calls `home_panel_mijia_model_parse()` to build compact model (line 1102)
  - Stores model in `g_mijia.family_model` (line 1118)
  - Logs: `[HOME][SYNC] revision=%u server=%u bytes=%u ...` (lines 1131-1137)
  - On HTTP 423: returns `-EACCES` (session locked)
  - On other errors: logs `[HOME][SYNC] request failed` (lines 1144-1146)

#### 2b. Delta Sync (`/api/sync/changes`)

**File:** `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/contest2026_011_ladelamuStudio/app/home_panel/home_panel_mijia_client.c`

- **Lines 1154-1564:** `mijia_wait_for_changes()`:
  - GET to `/api/sync/changes?after=<revision>&timeout=8` (long poll, line 1203)
  - Uses `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (line 1214)
  - Parses `changes`, `base_revision`, `revision`, `resync_required`, `stale`
  - Applies `device_online_changed` and `properties_changed` deltas to working model copy
  - Handles revision gaps: falls back to full resync (lines 1291-1298)
  - On stale server with empty changes: returns `-EAGAIN` (line 1329)
  - Logs delta stats: `[HOME][SYNC] delta server=%u bytes=%u methods=%u ...` (lines 1533-1538)

#### 2c. Worker Thread Sync Loop
